platform.uz: Learners Area — ingliz tilini mashq qilish platformasi 🙂 Reading, Listening, Writing, Speaking, lug‘at, grammatika va takrorlash bilan ishlashingiz mumkin. RIWI mavzuni tushuntiradi va ruxsat etilgan material bilan mashq qilishga yordam beradi. Qaysi ko‘nikmadan boshlaymiz?
platform.en: Learners Area supports English practice through reading, listening, writing, speaking, vocabulary, grammar and review. RIWI explains supported topics and helps with material available to your account. Which skill shall we work on?

start.uz: Avval maqsadingizni va hozir qaysi ishni mustaqil bajara olishingizni aniqlaymiz. Boshlash uchun: 1) o‘zingiz haqingizda uchta inglizcha gap yozing; 2) qisqa matnning asosiy fikrini ayting; 3) qaysi joyi qiyinligini belgilang. Shundan keyin mos grammatika va lug‘at mavzusini tanlaymiz. Bu rasmiy daraja testi emas.
start.en: Start with a small diagnostic: write three English sentences about yourself, summarise a short text, and identify what was difficult. We can then choose suitable grammar and vocabulary. This is practice, not an official level certification.

access-details.uz: Bu imkoniyatning aynan sizdagi holati akkaunt, kurs va material ruxsatiga bog‘liq. Men obuna narxi, kunlik limit, yangi material sanasi yoki oflayn yuklash borligini dalilsiz tasdiqlamayman. Qaysi bo‘lim va ekrandagi qaysi tugma yoki xabar haqida so‘rayotganingizni yozing; maxfiy ma’lumot yubormang.
access-details.en: Availability depends on your account, course and material permissions. I cannot verify prices, daily limits, release schedules or offline downloads from this question alone. Name the section and the button or message you see; leave out private information.

weekly-plan.uz: Boshlang‘ich haftalik reja: dushanba — bitta Reading matni va xato tahlili; seshanba — qisqa Listening va transkript bilan solishtirish; chorshanba — bitta grammatika mavzusi va uch gap; payshanba — Writing reja va paragraf; juma — Speaking yozuvi; shanba — eng qiyin mashqni qayta ishlash; yakshanba — yengil takrorlash. Kuniga qancha vaqt va qanday maqsad borligini yozsangiz, hajmini moslaymiz. Band yoki muddat kafolati yo‘q.
weekly-plan.en: Try a weekly rotation: Monday reading and error review; Tuesday listening and transcript comparison; Wednesday grammar and three sentences; Thursday a writing plan and paragraph; Friday speaking practice; Saturday your hardest task; Sunday light review. Tell me your available time and goal so we can adjust the workload. No band or completion date is guaranteed.

progress-meaning.uz: Progress — bajarilgan mashqlar va tekshirilgan natijalarning qaydi; uni umumiy til darajasi bilan tenglashtirmang. To‘g‘ri javob ulushi, vaqt va takroriy xato turini birga solishtiring. Saqlanish yoki yo‘qolish holatini aniq bilish uchun tegishli natija sahifasidagi status kerak; ko‘rinmagan natijani tiklandi deb ayta olmayman.
progress-meaning.en: Progress records completed activities and available results; it is not a complete measure of language ability. Compare accuracy, time and recurring error types. Saving or recovery needs evidence from the relevant result status; I cannot claim unseen work was restored.

languages.uz: O‘zbekcha va inglizcha yozishingiz mumkin 🙂 Keyingi javoblar tilini pastdagi «Javob tili» menyusidan UZ yoki ENG qilib tanlang. Bu sozlama eski xabarlarni qayta tarjima qilib yubormaydi. Kirill va ayrim imlo xatolarini taniyman, lekin tushunarsiz joyini aniqlashtirib so‘rashim mumkin.
languages.en: You can write in Uzbek or English. Choose UZ or ENG in the reply-language menu for future replies; it does not translate old messages. I recognise some Cyrillic and spelling variants, and may ask about unclear wording.

find-topic.uz: Asosiy menyudan tegishli modulni oching va mavzu yoki test nomini qidiring. RIWI’ga ham modul va aniq nomni yozishingiz mumkin: masalan, «Speaking beautiful object namuna javobini tushuntir». Men faqat sizga ochiq materialni topishga harakat qilaman; nom mos kelmasa aniqlashtiraman.
find-topic.en: Open the relevant module from Main and search by topic or test title. You can also name the module and exact material in chat. I only look for material your account may access, and ask for clarification when the title is unclear.

mobile.uz: Saytni telefon yoki kompyuter brauzerida ochib ishlatishingiz mumkin. Alohida ilova o‘rnatilgan deb hisoblamayman. Kichik ekranda biror boshqaruv ko‘rinmasa, sahifa nomi, qurilma va ekran yo‘nalishini yozing; kerak bo‘lsa maxfiy ma’lumotsiz rasm bilan xabar bering.
mobile.en: Use the site in a phone or computer browser. I do not assume a separate app is installed. If a control is missing on a small screen, report the page, device and screen orientation, with a redacted screenshot if useful.

repeat-practice.uz: Takrorlashni maqsad bilan bajaring: birinchi urinishda mustaqil ishlang, keyin xatoning sababini toping, so‘ng javobni ko‘rmasdan qayta bajaring. Shunchaki kalitni yodlash o‘sishni ko‘rsatmaydi. Yangi o‘xshash vazifada ham ishlay olishingizni tekshiring.
repeat-practice.en: Repeat with a purpose: attempt independently, identify why an error occurred, then retry without the key. Remembering the key is not evidence of improvement. Check whether you can transfer the skill to a new task.

technical-report.uz: Muammoni shunday tekshiramiz: 1) ish tugallanmagan bo‘lsa matnni alohida saqlang; 2) internet va shu sahifani qayta ochishni tekshiring; 3) takrorlansa, sahifa manzili, vaqt, brauzer/qurilma, bajargan qadamlaringiz va ko‘ringan xato matnini yozing. Parol, login kodi, token yoki shaxsiy javoblarni skrinshotdan yashiring. Men sababni dalilsiz «tuzatildi» deb belgilamayman.
technical-report.en: First preserve unfinished writing. Check your connection and reopen the page. If it repeats, report the page, time, browser/device, steps and exact visible error. Redact passwords, codes, tokens and private answers. I cannot claim the issue is fixed without evidence.

assessment-limits.uz: Mashqdagi tahlil va taxminiy feedback rasmiy imtihon natijasi emas. Matndan talaffuz yoki ravonlik ballini aniqlab bo‘lmaydi; buning uchun haqiqiy audio kerak. Writing’da vazifa talabi, fikrlarning bog‘lanishi, lug‘at va grammatika alohida ko‘riladi. Avval ishning o‘zi va mavjud mezon kerak; dalilsiz band o‘ylab topmayman.
assessment-limits.en: Practice feedback is not an official exam score. Text alone cannot establish pronunciation or spoken fluency; real audio is required. Writing feedback considers task fulfilment, organisation, vocabulary and grammar separately. I need the work and applicable criteria before drawing conclusions; I will not invent a band.

focus-skill.uz: Bitta ko‘nikmaga ko‘proq vaqt berish mumkin, ammo uni lug‘at va grammatika bilan bog‘lab mashq qiling. Bugun 10 daqiqa tushunish, 10 daqiqa qo‘llash va 5 daqiqa xatoni qayta ishlashdan boshlang. Qiyin bo‘layotgan vazifadan bitta misol yozing.
focus-skill.en: You can focus on one skill while connecting it to vocabulary and grammar. Try ten minutes understanding, ten minutes applying, and five minutes reviewing an error. Share one example of the task you find difficult.

login.uz: Kirish sahifasida hozir ko‘rsatilgan autentifikatsiya usulidan foydalaning; mavjud bo‘lmagan kirish yo‘lini va’da qilmayman. Rasmiy domenni tekshiring, tasdiqlashni o‘zingiz bajaring va kodni chatga yubormang. Tugma ishlamasa, ko‘ringan xato matnini maxfiy ma’lumotsiz yozing.
login.en: Use an authentication method actually shown on the login page; I cannot promise another method exists. Check the official domain, complete verification yourself, and never send the code in chat. If it fails, share the visible error without secrets.

account-scope.uz: Profil menyusi orqali hisobingiz va ko‘rinadigan ma’lumotlarni tekshiring. Rol, guruhga biriktirish, akkauntni o‘chirish yoki kontaktni o‘zgartirish suhbatdagi da’vo bilan bajarilmaydi: tegishli ruxsatli jarayon kerak. Men bu savoldan hisobingizdagi shaxsiy maydonlar yoki faol sessiyalar holatini tasdiqlay olmayman.
account-scope.en: Check your visible account details in the profile menu. Role assignment, group membership, account deletion and contact changes require their authorised workflows. A chat claim grants no permission, and this question does not verify private fields or active sessions.

logout.uz: Profil menyusidan chiqishni tanlang va umumiy qurilmada hisobni ochiq qoldirmang. Begona kirishdan shubhalansangiz, rasmiy tiklash yoki faol sessiyalarni boshqarish yo‘lidan foydalaning va mas’ul yordamga xabar bering. Login havolasi, OTP, cookie, token, parol va API kalitini hech kimga yubormang; RIWI ham ularni so‘ramaydi.
logout.en: Sign out through the profile menu, especially on a shared device. Suspected unauthorised access should go through the official recovery or session-management process and support. Never share login links, OTPs, cookies, tokens, passwords or API keys; RIWI does not need them.

privacy.uz: O‘quvchi faqat o‘ziga tegishli ruxsatli ma’lumotni ko‘radi. Teacher uchun o‘quvchi backendda unga biriktirilgan bo‘lishi kerak; adminning operatsion vakolati shaxsiy akademik tafsilotlarni ochmaydi. Boshqa odamning bahosi, yozishmasi, telefoni yoki audio yozuvini bu chat orqali ruxsatsiz bermayman.
privacy.en: Students may access their own permitted records. Teachers need a current server-verified learner assignment. Administrative access does not grant access to individual academic details. I will not disclose another person’s grades, chats, contacts or recordings without the required scope.

saving.uz: Brauzer keshini yoki cookie’ni o‘chirish akkauntni butunlay o‘chirish bilan bir xil emas, ammo sessiya yoki hali serverga yuborilmagan matn yo‘qolishi mumkin. Avval muhim qoralamani alohida saqlang. Keyin tegishli sahifadagi saqlangan statusni tekshiring; boshqa tab yoki qurilmaga avtomatik ko‘chdi deb taxmin qilmang.
saving.en: Clearing browser data is not the same as deleting an account, but it may remove a session or unsent text. Preserve important drafts first. Check the saved status on the relevant page rather than assuming another tab or device received the latest changes.

login-public.uz: Ochiq sahifalar kirishsiz ko‘rinishi mumkin; shaxsiy kurs, mashq va natijalar uchun sessiya va ruxsat talab qilinadi. Kirish usuli ishlamasa, boshqa hisobga o‘tib himoyani chetlab o‘tish o‘rniga xato matnini yordamga yuboring.
login-public.en: Public pages may remain accessible, while personal courses, tasks and results require a valid session and permissions. Report a failed login method rather than attempting to bypass access controls.

main-back.uz: Yuqoridagi «Main» havolasi asosiy sahifaga qaytaradi. Brauzerning Back tugmasi oldingi sahifaga, Forward esa keyingisiga o‘tadi; yangilash belgisi joriy sahifani qayta yuklaydi. Tugallanmagan yozuv bo‘lsa, avval saqlanganini tekshiring.
main-back.en: The Main link returns to the main page. Browser Back and Forward navigate your history; Reload loads the current page again. Check that unfinished writing is saved before leaving.

appearance.uz: Yuqoridagi kunduz/tun tugmalari ko‘rinish rejimini o‘zgartiradi. Kattalashgan sahifa uchun brauzer zoomini tekshiring; matnni o‘qishga qulay hajmda qoldiring. Tugma rangidan uning vazifasini taxmin qilmang — nomini o‘qing. Ko‘rinish xatosida sahifa va qurilmani aniq ko‘rsating.
appearance.en: Use the day/night controls for appearance and check browser zoom if the page looks enlarged. Keep text readable. Read a button’s label rather than guessing its action from colour. Report visual problems with the page and device details.

reload.uz: Oddiy Reload sahifani yana yuklaydi; keshni chetlab yangilash usuli brauzer va tizimga bog‘liq. Har ikkisi ham serverdagi ma’lumot o‘zgarganini isbotlamaydi. Avval qoralamangizni saqlang, keyin versiya yoki muammoni qayta tekshiring.
reload.en: Reload fetches the page again; bypassing cache depends on your browser and operating system. Neither proves server data changed. Preserve drafts before reloading, then recheck the behaviour.

audio-device.uz: Avval qurilma ovozi, chiqish qurilmasi va player holatini tekshiring. Mikrofon yozuvi uchun saytga mikrofon ruxsati kerak; oddiy tinglash uchun mikrofonni yoqish shart emas. Sahifa xatosi davom etsa, brauzer va aniq xabarni yozing. Men bu matnli chatda ovozingizni eshitganimni yoki qurilma sinovidan o‘tganini ayta olmayman.
audio-device.en: Check device volume, audio output and player state. Recording needs microphone permission; playback does not require enabling your microphone. Report the browser and exact error if it persists. This text chat cannot establish that I heard you or that your device passed an audio test.

reading-format.uz: Academic Reading odatda uchta uzun matn; General Training esa kundalik va ish hayoti matnlari bilan uch bo‘limdan tuziladi. Ikkalasida 40 savol va jami 60 daqiqa bor. Mashqda 18–20 daqiqalik bo‘lakdan boshlang, qiyin savolni belgilab keyingisiga o‘ting va tekshirishga vaqt qoldiring. Saytdagi aniq test hajmini uning yo‘riqnomasidan tekshiring.
reading-format.en: Academic Reading uses three long texts; General Training uses three sections with everyday and workplace material. Both have 40 questions in 60 minutes. Practise in 18–20-minute blocks, move past a stuck question, and leave checking time. Check the specific site task instructions as practice sets may differ.

reading-method.uz: Avval savol talabini aniqlang. Skimming — matnning umumiy fikrini tez tushunish; scanning — ism, sana yoki kerakli faktni qidirish. Topilgan joyning oldingi-keyingi gapini diqqat bilan o‘qing: bir xil so‘zning o‘zi dalil emas. Har savol turi ketma-ket kelavermaydi. Masalan: 1) heading uchun paragraf maqsadi; 2) sana uchun raqam; 3) sabab uchun because/since va ma’no bog‘lanishini tekshiring.
reading-method.en: Identify what the question asks. Skimming finds the overall message; scanning locates a name, date or detail. Read the surrounding sentences closely: a repeated keyword alone is not proof. Not every task type follows text order. For example, seek paragraph purpose for headings, a number for dates, and the meaning of causal links for reasons.

completed-review.uz: Tahlil uchun savol, sizning javobingiz va tegishli gap yoki tugallangan urinish kerak. Xatoni uch tomondan ko‘ramiz: dalilni topish, ma’noni tushunish, format/imlo. Faqat o‘zingizga ochilgan yakunlangan test izohini ishlataman; yopiq kalitni taxmin qilmayman. Savol matnini yoki ruxsat etilgan natija sahifasidagi izohni yozing.
completed-review.en: Review needs the question, your answer and the relevant passage or completed attempt. We can separate errors in locating evidence, understanding meaning, and formatting/spelling. Only released feedback for an authorised completed attempt may be used; I will not infer a hidden key. Share the question or permitted result explanation.

word-limit.uz: Yo‘riqnomadagi so‘z va raqam chegarasiga aynan rioya qiling. «ONE WORD ONLY» — bitta so‘z; ortiqcha so‘z javobni yaroqsiz qilishi mumkin. Imlo va gapga grammatik moslikni ham tekshiring. Masalan: 1) school — bitta so‘z; 2) primary school — ikki so‘z; 3) 15 May — bitta raqam va bitta so‘z. Javob formatini faqat katta harf yozish bilan tuzatib bo‘lmaydi.
word-limit.en: Follow the exact word/number limit and check spelling and grammatical fit. ONE WORD ONLY permits one word; an extra word may invalidate an answer. For example: school is one word, primary school is two, and 15 May is one number plus one word. Capitalisation alone cannot fix a wrong answer.

exam-boundary.uz: Practice va baholanadigan imtihonning yordami bir xil emas. Mashqda usul va ruxsatli matnni o‘rganamiz; faol yoki yopiq imtihonda tayyor javob, kalit yoki sizning o‘rningizga topshirishni bermayman. Boshlash, qayta urinish, audio va taymer qoidalarini aynan o‘sha test yo‘riqnomasidan tekshiring. Umumiy yechish strategiyasini tushuntira olaman.
exam-boundary.en: Practice and graded exams allow different kinds of assistance. Practice may include methods and permitted text; I cannot provide active or unreleased exam keys or submit work for you. Starting, retrying, audio and timer rules must be checked in that task’s instructions. I can explain general strategies.

listening-format.uz: Listening to‘rt qism va jami 40 savoldan iborat. Dastlabki ikki qism kundalik vaziyatlar, keyingi ikkitasi o‘qish yoki ta’lim mavzularidir. Rasmiy test yozuvi bir marta eshittiriladi; saytdagi practice qayta tinglash qoidasi player va rejimga bog‘liq. Mashqda avval mustaqil tinglang, keyin xato joyini qayta eshitib sababini toping.
listening-format.en: Listening has four parts and 40 questions. The first two concern everyday settings; the last two concern education or training. Official recordings are played once. Replay in site practice depends on its mode and player. Attempt independently first, then replay difficult sections to identify the cause of an error.

listening-method.uz: Audio oldidan bo‘sh joy uchun qanday ma’no va so‘z turkumi kerakligini taxmin qiling. Tinglaganda o‘zgartirilgan fikrni ushlang: «Tuesday — sorry, Thursday» desa oxirgi tuzatish muhim. O‘tkazib yuborgan bitta javobda qolib ketmang. Mashqdan keyin: 1) xato qismini qayta eshiting; 2) ruxsatli transkript bilan solishtiring; 3) qiyin iborani aytib, yangi gapda ishlating.
listening-method.en: Before the audio, predict the meaning and word class needed. Listen for corrections: in Tuesday—sorry, Thursday, the final correction matters. Move on after a missed answer. After practice, replay the difficult section, compare an available transcript, then say the difficult phrase and use it in a new sentence.

band-conversion.uz: Overall band — Listening, Reading, Writing va Speaking bandlarining o‘rtachasi, eng yaqin yarim bandga yaxlitlanadi. Masalan, o‘rtacha 6.25 bo‘lsa 6.5 bo‘ladi. Reading/Listening xom balli 40 savoldagi to‘g‘ri javoblar sonidir; aniq band chegarasi test va Reading turiga bog‘liq. Bitta xom ballni barcha testlar uchun kafolatli band deb ko‘rsatmang.
band-conversion.en: The overall band is the average of the four skill bands, rounded to the nearest half band; 6.25 becomes 6.5. Reading and Listening raw scores count correct answers out of 40. Exact band thresholds depend on the test and Reading type, so a raw score is not a guaranteed band across all tests.

writing-format.uz: Academic Task 1 grafik, jadval yoki jarayonni kamida 150 so‘zda tasvirlaydi; Task 2 esa kamida 250 so‘zli insho. Jami 60 daqiqa: taxminan 20 va 40 daqiqa ajrating; Task 2 vazni kattaroq. Task 1’da ko‘rinadigan ma’lumotni taqqoslang, shaxsiy fikr qo‘shmang. Task 2’da savolning barcha qismlariga dalil va misol bilan javob bering. GT Task 1 — vaziyatga mos xat.
writing-format.en: Academic Task 1 describes visual information in at least 150 words; Task 2 is an essay of at least 250 words. There are 60 minutes: roughly 20 for Task 1 and 40 for Task 2, which carries more weight. Task 1 reports the data rather than personal opinions; Task 2 addresses every part with reasons and examples. General Training Task 1 is a letter.

overview.uz: Overview — eng katta umumiy yo‘nalishlar, barcha raqamlar ro‘yxati emas. Avval nima oshgan/kamayganini yoki eng katta farqni tanlang, keyin tafsilotlarda dalil keltiring. Uchta namuna: 1) Overall, sales rose in both regions. — Umuman, ikkala hududda ham sotuv oshdi. 2) The north remained the largest market. — Shimol eng katta bozor bo‘lib qoldi. 3) In contrast, demand fell in the south. — Aksincha, janubda talab kamaydi. Bularni grafik ma’lumotiga mos bo‘lsagina ishlating.
overview.en: An overview selects major trends or contrasts, not every number. Example sentences: Overall, sales rose in both regions. The north remained the largest market. In contrast, demand fell in the south. These are invented practice examples; use a statement only when the actual chart supports it.

writing-input.uz: Savol sharti va o‘zingiz yozgan gap yoki paragrafni yuboring. Avval asosiy fikrni, keyin dalil va bog‘lanishni, oxirida grammatikani ko‘ramiz. Men asl ma’noni saqlab, aniq qoida bilgan joyimdagina tuzatish taklif qilaman; barcha matnni tekshirdim deb asossiz aytmayman. Faol baholanadigan ishni o‘rningizga yozmayman.
writing-input.en: Share the task and your own sentence or paragraph. We can check the main point, supporting evidence, links and grammar in that order. I preserve the intended meaning and suggest corrections only where supported; I cannot certify an entire text without adequate analysis. I do not replace your work in an active graded task.

writing-ui.uz: Tegishli Writing yoki natija sahifasini ochib, ko‘rsatilgan task, urinish va tekshirish statusini tekshiring. Filtr, so‘z sanagich, yuklab olish yoki qayta topshirish imkoniyati ko‘rinmasa, bor deb ayta olmayman. Qaysi sahifa va status ekanini yozing; xatoni natijani o‘zgartirmasdan tekshirish yo‘lini tanlaymiz.
writing-ui.en: Open the relevant Writing or result page and check the task, attempt and review status. I cannot promise filtering, word counting, downloads or resubmission unless available there. Name the page and status so we can investigate without changing results.

writing-time.uz: 40 daqiqalik Task 2 mashqi: 5 daqiqa savol va reja, 30 daqiqa yozish, 5 daqiqa tekshirish. Rejada pozitsiya + ikkita asosiy sabab + har biriga bitta misol bo‘lsin. Tekshiruvda savolning barcha qismlariga javob, fe’l shakli va gap chegaralarini ko‘ring. Taymerni o‘zingiz boshlang; men uni ishga tushirdim deb aytmayman.
writing-time.en: For a 40-minute Task 2 practice, spend five minutes planning, thirty writing and five checking. Plan a position, two reasons and an example for each. Check task coverage, verb forms and sentence boundaries. Start your own timer; I have not started one for you.

speaking-format.uz: Speaking’da Part 1 — shaxsiy va kundalik savollar; Part 2 — tayyorgarlikdan keyin uzunroq mustaqil javob; Part 3 — shu yo‘nalishdagi umumiyroq muhokama. Mashqda javob + sabab + misol bilan fikrni rivojlantiring. Tushunarlilik muhim; muayyan aksent yoki yodlangan murakkab so‘zning o‘zi yuqori band bermaydi. Matnli chat ovozli ijroni baholamaydi.
speaking-format.en: Part 1 uses familiar personal questions, Part 2 an extended individual turn after preparation, and Part 3 a broader discussion. Practise an answer, a reason and an example. Intelligibility matters; an accent or memorised difficult word does not itself establish a high band. Text chat cannot assess spoken delivery.

speaking-ui.uz: Speaking practice sahifasidagi savolni oching. Vocabulary, Ideas yoki Sample yordami ko‘rsatilgan bo‘lsa, uning tugmasi yo‘riqnomasiga amal qiling; namuna o‘zingizning hayotiy tajribangiz o‘rnini bosmaydi. Audio uchun aynan yozuv vositasi va mikrofon ruxsati kerak. RIWI’ga matn yozish audio yuborish bilan bir xil emas.
speaking-ui.en: Open a question in Speaking practice. Use Vocabulary, Ideas or Sample support only where shown and follow its control instructions. A sample does not replace your own experience. Audio requires the recording interface and microphone permission; typing in RIWI is not an audio submission.

speaking-method.uz: Yodlangan uzun skript o‘rniga fikrni kengaytirishni mashq qilamiz 🙂 Avval javob, keyin sabab, so‘ng bitta haqiqiy misol. 10 daqiqa: 2 daqiqa g‘oya, 3 daqiqa aytish, 3 daqiqa qayta tinglash/o‘qish, 2 daqiqa bir xatoni tuzatish. Boshlang: What do you enjoy doing in your free time, and why? Javobingizdan keyin keyingi savolni tanlaymiz.
speaking-method.en: Practise developing an answer rather than memorising a long script: answer, reason, then a genuine example. In ten minutes, use two for ideas, three speaking, three reviewing and two fixing one issue. Start with: What do you enjoy doing in your free time, and why? We can choose a follow-up after your response.

minimal-pairs.uz: Talaffuzni ovoz bilan solishtirish kerak; matndan sizning talaffuzingizga ball qo‘ymayman. Uch juftlik: ship /ʃɪp/ — sheep /ʃiːp/; bit /bɪt/ — beat /biːt/; thin /θɪn/ — tin /tɪn/. Avval farqni tinglang, keyin bittadan ayting, yozuvni tekshiring. /θ/ uchun til uchi tishlar orasiga yaqin keladi, havo ishqalanib chiqadi; /t/ kabi to‘liq to‘xtamaydi.
minimal-pairs.en: Pronunciation needs audio comparison; text does not establish your pronunciation score. Try ship /ʃɪp/ versus sheep /ʃiːp/, bit /bɪt/ versus beat /biːt/, and thin /θɪn/ versus tin /tɪn/. Listen, produce each word and review a recording. For /θ/, air passes with friction near the teeth rather than stopping as for /t/.

vocabulary-ui.uz: Lug‘atda so‘zni alohida qidiring, so‘ng so‘z turkumi, ma’no va misolni matndagi vaziyat bilan solishtiring. Shaxsiy papka yoki o‘yin uchun faqat o‘sha sahifada bor boshqaruvdan foydalaning; ball formulasi yoki avtomatik importni ko‘rmasdan tasdiqlamayman. Qaysi so‘z va qaysi tugmada muammo borligini yozing. Bir so‘zning barcha ma’nolari bitta darajaga tegishli bo‘lavermaydi.
vocabulary-ui.en: Search the word and compare its part of speech, sense and example with your context. Use only controls actually offered for personal folders or games; I cannot verify scoring formulas or automatic imports without evidence. Name the word and the control involved. Different senses need not have the same learning level.

cefr.uz: CEFR A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 va C2 darajalari tilni qanday ishlata olishingizni tasvirlaydi. Alohida so‘zdagi belgi butun darajangizni aniqlamaydi: masalan, oddiy so‘zning murakkab ma’nosi ham bor. So‘zni taniymanmi, kontekstda tushunamanmi va o‘zim gapda ishlata olamanmi — shu uch savol bilan tekshiring.
cefr.en: CEFR levels A1 through C2 describe language-use ability. A label on one word does not determine your overall level, and a familiar word may have a more advanced sense. Check recognition, understanding in context and independent use.

vocab-review.uz: Bugun beshta kerakli so‘zni tanlang. Har biriga qisqa ma’no, tabiiy birikma va o‘zingiz haqingizda bitta gap yozing. Ertaga javobni yopib eslang; bir necha kundan keyin yangi gapda qo‘llang. Sinash uchun so‘zlaringizni yuboring — ma’no topish, bo‘sh joy va yangi gap tuzish savollarini navbat bilan ishlaymiz. Ro‘yxatni ko‘rmasdan sizning shaxsiy so‘zlaringizni bilaman deb aytmayman.
vocab-review.en: Choose five useful words and record a meaning, natural combination and personal example. Recall them without looking tomorrow, then use them in new sentences after a few days. Share your list for meaning, gap-fill and sentence-production practice; I cannot see an unspecified personal list.

spelling-varieties.uz: Britancha va amerikancha shakllarning ikkalasi ham kontekstga mos bo‘lsa ishlatiladi; bitta matnda izchillikni saqlang. Uch misol: colour — color; centre — center; organise — organize. Talaffuz farqi faqat yozilish bilan cheklanmaydi; bir xil so‘zni ishonchli audio bilan solishtiring.
spelling-varieties.en: British and American forms can both be appropriate; keep your choices consistent within a text. Examples: colour/color, centre/center and organise/organize. Pronunciation differences are not fully captured by spelling, so compare reliable recordings of the same word.

present-comparison.uz: Present simple odat va umumiy holatni, present continuous esa davom etayotgan yoki vaqtinchalik ishni ko‘rsatadi. Uch juftlik: 1) I work at home. — Uyda ishlayman. / I am working at home today. — Bugun uyda ishlayapman. 2) She reads every evening. — U har oqshom o‘qiydi. / She is reading now. — U hozir o‘qiyapti. 3) They play on Sundays. — Ular yakshanba kunlari o‘ynaydi. / They are playing now. — Ular hozir o‘ynayapti. Endi o‘zingiz haqingizda odat va hozirgi ishni yozing.
present-comparison.en: Present simple describes habits or general states; present continuous describes an ongoing or temporary action. Compare: I work at home / I am working at home today; She reads every evening / She is reading now; They play on Sundays / They are playing now. Write one habit and one current action about yourself.

future-continuous.uz: Future continuous: will be + V-ing. Kelajakdagi ma’lum paytda davom etayotgan ishni tasvirlaydi. 1) At eight, I will be studying. — Soat sakkizda o‘qiyotgan bo‘laman. 2) This time tomorrow, we will be travelling. — Ertaga shu paytda safarda ketayotgan bo‘lamiz. 3) She will be working when you arrive. — Siz kelganingizda u ishlayotgan bo‘ladi. Oddiy reja va o‘sha paytda davom etayotgan jarayonni ajrating.
future-continuous.en: Future continuous uses will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time. Examples: At eight, I will be studying. This time tomorrow, we will be travelling. She will be working when you arrive. Distinguish the ongoing activity at that time from a simple future event.

conditional-comparison.uz: First conditional real ehtimolli kelajak uchun: if + present, will + V. Second conditional faraziy yoki hozirgi haqiqatga zid holat uchun: if + past, would + V. 1) If it rains, I will stay home. — Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolaman. 2) If I had a car, I would drive there. — Mashinam bo‘lsa edi, u yerga haydab borardim. 3) If I were you, I would ask. — O‘rningizda bo‘lsam, so‘rardim. Shaklni emas, vaziyatning qanchalik real ekanini ham tekshiring.
conditional-comparison.en: The first conditional commonly uses if + present, will + verb for a real future possibility. The second uses if + past, would + verb for a hypothetical situation. Examples: If it rains, I will stay home. If I had a car, I would drive there. If I were you, I would ask. Consider the intended likelihood, not just the form.

advanced-grammar.uz: Uch foydali tuzilma: 1) Never have I seen this before. — Buni ilgari hech ko‘rmaganman; inkor ifodadan keyin inversion. 2) It was Ali who called. — Aynan Ali qo‘ng‘iroq qildi; cleft gap diqqatni Aliga qaratadi. 3) She likes reading, writing and swimming. — U o‘qish, yozish va suzishni yoqtiradi; parallel shakl saqlangan. Qaysi tuzilmani nazarda tutganingizni yozing, uning savol/inkor shaklini alohida ko‘ramiz.
advanced-grammar.en: Three useful structures: Never have I seen this before illustrates inversion after a negative expression. It was Ali who called is a cleft focusing on Ali. She likes reading, writing and swimming keeps a parallel pattern. Name the construction you want so we can study its questions, negatives and limits.

grammar-practice.uz: Bitta qoidani uch bosqichda mashq qilamiz: tushunish, xatoni topish, mustaqil gap yozish. Masalan: 1) She works here. — U shu yerda ishlaydi. 2) Does she work here? — U shu yerda ishlaydimi? 3) She does not work here. — U shu yerda ishlamaydi. Does kelganda work’ga yana -s qo‘shilmaydi. Endi «he / study English» bilan shu uch shaklni o‘zingiz tuzing.
grammar-practice.en: Use three stages: understand a rule, identify an error, then produce your own sentence. Compare She works here; Does she work here?; She does not work here. After does, work takes no extra -s. Now make the same three forms with he / study English.

mock-schedule.uz: Jadval, qatnashuv, yozuv, topshiriq va support holatlari jonli hisob ma’lumotiga bog‘liq. Tegishli bo‘lim yoki bildirishnomada ko‘ringan sana va statusni tekshiring; men bu savoldan navbatdagi dars vaqtini yoki qatnashganingizni bilmayman. Shaxsiy havolani ommaga tarqatmang. Qaysi dars yoki murojaat haqida so‘rayotganingizni aniq yozing.
mock-schedule.en: Schedules, attendance, recordings, assignments and support status require current account information. Check the relevant section or notification for the date and status; this question alone does not establish a next class time or attendance. Do not publish private access links. Name the class or request concerned.

media-study.uz: Media mashqi uchun qisqa bo‘lak tanlang. Avval umumiy fikrni tinglab ayting; keyin ruxsatli transkript bilan noma’lum joyni solishtiring; oxirida uchta asosiy fikr va o‘zingizning bitta gapingizni yozing. Aniq epizodni tahlil qilish uchun uning nomini ayting. Transkript yoki video ochilmagan bo‘lsa, uning mazmunini ko‘rdim deb aytmayman.
media-study.en: Choose a short media segment. First listen for its main point, then compare unclear parts with an available transcript. Finish with three key points and one sentence of your own. Name the episode for specific analysis; I cannot claim to have seen content that was not available.

identity.uz: Men RIWI — Learners Area’dagi matnli o‘quv yordamchisiman 🙂 Odam ham, katta LLM agent ham emasman; ichki qoidalar va mavjud bilimlar bilan ishlayman. Ism yoki boshqa shaxsiy ma’lumot aytmasdan savol berishingiz mumkin. Atamaning ma’nosi, grammatika, mashq yoki sayt bo‘yicha bitta savoldan boshlaymiz. RIWI nomining tasdiqlanmagan kengaytmasini o‘ylab topmayman.
identity.en: I am RIWI, the text learning assistant in Learners Area. I am not a person or a large LLM agent; I use internal rules and available knowledge. You can ask without sharing your name. Start with a word, grammar point, practice task or site question. I will not invent an expansion of the name RIWI.

honest-limits.uz: Bilimim va qoidalarim cheklangan. Mos, tekshirilgan javob bo‘lmasa, bilmayman deyman yoki kerakli kontekstni so‘rayman. Men doimiy jonli internet qidiruvi, eng so‘nggi narx yoki yangilikni tekshirish imkoniga ega emasman. Muhim ma’lumotni tegishli rasmiy joyda qayta tekshiring; taxminni tasdiqlangan fakt qilib ko‘rsatmayman.
honest-limits.en: My knowledge and rules are limited. Without a reliable match, I say so or ask for context. I do not have continuous live web search or verified current prices and news. Check important information with the appropriate official service; I will not present a guess as a verified fact.

privacy-retention.uz: Shu faol suhbatdagi ruxsat etilgan kontekst keyingi savolni tushunishga yordam beradi. «/clear» yoki «/new chat» keyingi suhbat uchun bu kontekstni uzadi; bu buyruqlar serverdagi barcha yozuvlar butunlay o‘chirildi degani emas. Suhbatlar amaldagi saqlash muddatiga bo‘ysunadi. Xabarni avtomatik ravishda hamma uchun ishonchli bilim deb qabul qilmayman.
privacy-retention.en: Permitted context in the current conversation can help with follow-ups. /clear and /new chat reset the context used for future turns; they do not claim to permanently erase every server record. Conversations follow retention rules. A chat statement is not automatically accepted as shared knowledge.

question-style.uz: Savolni mavzu + qiyin joy + misol shaklida yozing 🙂 Masalan: «Present perfect’da have nega kerak? I have finished degan gapni tushuntir». Davomiy savolda faol suhbatdagi mavzuni ishlataman; bir nechta ma’no bo‘lsa, qaysi birini nazarda tutganingizni so‘rayman. Aniq matn yoki variant bo‘lmasa, ko‘rdim yoki solishtirdim deb aytmayman.
question-style.en: Try topic + difficult point + example, such as Why does present perfect need have in I have finished? Follow-ups can use the current conversation; I ask when the reference is ambiguous. Without the actual text or options, I cannot claim to have reviewed or compared them.

greeting.uz: Salom! Shu yerdaman 🙂 Bugun bitta qiyin joyni birga aniqlab olamiz. Inglizcha gap, tushunmagan qoida yoki sayt bo‘yicha savolingizni yozing.
greeting.en: Hi, I’m here 🙂 Share an English sentence, a confusing rule or a site question, and we can work through one difficulty together.

thanks-bye.uz: Arzimaydi 🙂 Bugungi o‘rganganingizdan bitta qoidani eslab, bitta yangi gapda ishlating. Keyin davom ettirishga tayyor bo‘lsangiz, shu mavzuni yoki yangi savolni yozing.
thanks-bye.en: You’re welcome 🙂 Recall one rule from today and use it in a new sentence. When you return, name that topic or ask a new question.

actually.uz:
Actually — «aslida», «to‘g‘risini aytganda». U ko‘pincha oldingi taxminni tuzatadi; «hozir» degani emas.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Actually, I live in Namangan.
— Aslida, men Namanganda yashayman.
2) I thought it was easy, but it was actually difficult.
— Oson deb o‘ylagandim, ammo aslida qiyin ekan.
3) Actually, we have already met.
— Aslida, biz allaqachon tanishganmiz.
actually.en:
Actually often corrects an assumption or adds a surprising fact. It does not mean currently.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Actually, I live in Namangan.
2) I thought it was easy, but it was actually difficult.
3) Actually, we have already met.

eventually.uz:
Eventually — vaqt yoki qiyinchilikdan keyin «oxir-oqibat». Finally — kutish tugaganini, oxirgi bosqichni yoki ro‘yxatdagi yakuniy fikrni bildirishi mumkin.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) We eventually found the address.
— Oxir-oqibat manzilni topdik.
2) The bus finally arrived!
— Avtobus nihoyat keldi!
3) Finally, check your spelling.
— Oxirida imloni tekshiring.
eventually.en:
Eventually means in the end after some time or difficulty. Finally can express relief, the last step or the final point in a sequence.

🧩 Three examples:
1) We eventually found the address.
2) The bus finally arrived!
3) Finally, check your spelling.

although-despite.uz:
Although’dan keyin ega + fe’l keladi. Despite’dan keyin ot yoki V-ing keladi; despite of emas. Despite the fact that’dan keyin esa to‘liq gap mumkin.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Although it rained, we played.
— Yomg‘ir yog‘sa ham o‘ynadik.
2) Despite the rain, we played.
— Yomg‘irga qaramay o‘ynadik.
3) Despite feeling tired, she continued.
— Charchaganiga qaramay u davom etdi.
although-despite.en:
Although introduces a clause. Despite takes a noun or -ing form, without of. Despite the fact that can introduce a full clause.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Although it rained, we played.
2) Despite the rain, we played.
3) Despite feeling tired, she continued.

used-to.uz:
Used to + V — ilgari bo‘lgan, hozir esa o‘zgargan odat yoki holat. Be used to + ot/V-ing esa «ko‘nikkan» degani; ular bir xil emas.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I used to walk to school.
— Ilgari maktabga piyoda borardim.
2) She used to live here.
— U ilgari shu yerda yashardi.
3) I am used to getting up early.
— Erta turishga ko‘nikkanman.
used-to.en:
Used to + base verb describes a former habit or state that has changed. Be used to + noun/-ing means be accustomed to something.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I used to walk to school.
2) She used to live here.
3) I am used to getting up early.

would-rather.uz:
Would rather + oddiy fe’l — «...ni afzal ko‘rardim». Bir kishining tanlovi uchun to qo‘shilmaydi. Boshqa odamning ishini xohlasangiz, ko‘pincha would rather + ega + past shakl ishlatiladi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I would rather stay home.
— Uyda qolishni afzal ko‘rardim.
2) She would rather walk than drive.
— U mashina haydashdan ko‘ra piyoda yurishni afzal ko‘radi.
3) I would rather you came tomorrow.
— Ertaga kelganingizni ma’qul ko‘rardim.
would-rather.en:
Would rather + base verb expresses preference. It takes no to for the same subject. For another person’s action, would rather + subject + past form is common.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I would rather stay home.
2) She would rather walk than drive.
3) I would rather you came tomorrow.

as-long-as.uz:
As long as shart ma’nosida «...bo‘lsa», «...sharti bilan» degani. Kelajak shartida undan keyin odatda present simple ishlatiladi. Boshqa vaziyatda davomiylikni ham bildirishi mumkin.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) You can borrow it as long as you return it.
— Qaytarsangiz, uni olib turishingiz mumkin.
2) We will go as long as the weather is fine.
— Havo yaxshi bo‘lsa boramiz.
3) Stay as long as you need.
— Qancha kerak bo‘lsa, shuncha qoling.
as-long-as.en:
As long as can mean provided that. In a future condition, it usually takes a present form. In other contexts it can describe duration.

🧩 Three examples:
1) You can borrow it as long as you return it.
2) We will go as long as the weather is fine.
3) Stay as long as you need.

interested.uz:
Interested in odatda mavzu yoki faoliyatga qiziqishni bildiradi: ot/V-ing. Interested to hear/learn esa biror yangilikni bilishga qiziqishni yoki unga munosabatni ifodalaydi. Har fe’l bilan to ishlatib bo‘lmaydi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I am interested in history.
— Tarixga qiziqaman.
2) She is interested in learning English.
— U ingliz tilini o‘rganishga qiziqadi.
3) I would be interested to hear your view.
— Fikringizni eshitish menga qiziq bo‘lardi.
interested.en:
Interested in commonly introduces a topic or activity with a noun/-ing form. Interested to hear/learn expresses interest in learning information; to is not freely interchangeable with in.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I am interested in history.
2) She is interested in learning English.
3) I would be interested to hear your view.

borrow-lend.uz:
Borrow — boshqa kishidan vaqtincha olish. Lend — boshqaga vaqtincha berish. Yo‘nalishni tekshiring: borrow from, lend to.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Can I borrow your pen?
— Ruchkangizni olib tursam bo‘ladimi?
2) I lent my book to Ali.
— Kitobimni Aliga berib turdim.
3) She borrowed a bike from me.
— U mendan velosiped olib turdi.
borrow-lend.en:
Borrow means receive something temporarily; lend means give it temporarily. Check the direction: borrow from, lend to.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Can I borrow your pen?
2) I lent my book to Ali.
3) She borrowed a bike from me.

say-tell.uz:
Say — aytilgan gap; tell — odatda kimga aytilgani ham keladi. Speak — til yoki rasmiyroq gapirish, talk — suhbatlashish. Tell me, say to me; say me emas.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) She said hello.
— U salom dedi.
2) Tell me the story.
— Menga voqeani aytib bering.
3) We talked about school, and he spoke English.
— Maktab haqida suhbatlashdik, u inglizcha gapirdi.
say-tell.en:
Say focuses on words; tell commonly takes a person. Speak is used for languages and some formal contexts; talk often means converse. Use tell me or say to me, not say me.

🧩 Three examples:
1) She said hello.
2) Tell me the story.
3) We talked about school, and he spoke English.

job-work.uz:
Job — sanaladigan ish o‘rni yoki alohida vazifa. Work ish faoliyati ma’nosida odatda sanalmaydi; a work bu ma’noda ishlatilmaydi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) She has a new job.
— Uning yangi ishi bor.
2) I have a lot of work today.
— Bugun ishim ko‘p.
3) Painting the door is a small job.
— Eshikni bo‘yash — kichik bir vazifa.
job-work.en:
Job is countable: a position or task. Work is usually uncountable when it means employment or activity.

🧩 Three examples:
1) She has a new job.
2) I have a lot of work today.
3) Painting the door is a small job.

fun-funny.uz:
Fun — maroqli, zavqli. Funny — kulgili yoki kontekstga qarab g‘alati. A fun lesson qiziqarli dars; a funny joke kulgili hazil.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) The game was fun.
— O‘yin maroqli bo‘ldi.
2) That joke was funny.
— U hazil kulgili edi.
3) The engine makes a funny noise.
— Motor g‘alati ovoz chiqaryapti.
fun-funny.en:
Fun means enjoyable. Funny means amusing or sometimes strange. A fun activity need not make you laugh.

🧩 Three examples:
1) The game was fun.
2) That joke was funny.
3) The engine makes a funny noise.

meet-know.uz:
Meet — uchrashish yoki ilk tanishish. Get to know — vaqt davomida yaxshiroq tanib borish. Know — tanish/bilish holati.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I met her yesterday.
— U bilan kecha tanishdim yoki uchrashdim; kontekst muhim.
2) We got to know each other at school.
— Maktabda bir-birimizni yaxshiroq tanidik.
3) I know him well.
— Uni yaxshi taniyman.
meet-know.en:
Meet can describe an encounter or first introduction. Get to know is the process of becoming familiar; know is the resulting state.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I met her yesterday.
2) We got to know each other at school.
3) I know him well.

late.uz:
«Men bugun kech qoldim» — I was late today. Uzrda nimaga kechikkaningizni aniqlashtirish mumkin; excuse me e’tibor so‘rashda ham ishlatiladi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I was late today.
— Bugun kech qoldim.
2) I’m sorry I’m late.
— Kechikkanim uchun uzr.
3) Sorry for keeping you waiting.
— Sizni kuttirib qo‘yganim uchun uzr.
late.en:
I was late today describes arriving late. For an apology, say what happened briefly and take responsibility.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I was late today.
2) I’m sorry I’m late.
3) Sorry for keeping you waiting.

if-time.uz:
«Vaqtim bo‘lsa, yordam beraman» — If I have time, I will help. Kelajakdagi real shartni if ichida present simple, asosiy gapda will bilan ifodalash mumkin.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) If I have time, I will help.
— Vaqtim bo‘lsa, yordam beraman.
2) If she calls, I will answer.
— U qo‘ng‘iroq qilsa, javob beraman.
3) If we finish early, we will walk home.
— Erta tugatsak, uyga piyoda qaytamiz.
if-time.en:
If I have time, I will help expresses a real future condition. The if clause uses a present form, not will have in this ordinary pattern.

🧩 Three examples:
1) If I have time, I will help.
2) If she calls, I will answer.
3) If we finish early, we will walk home.

seen-before.uz:
«Men buni oldin ham ko‘rganman» — I have seen this before. Aniq tugagan vaqt aytilmasa, oldingi tajriba hozir bilan bog‘lanadi. Yesterday kabi tugagan vaqt bilan odatda past simple tanlanadi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I have seen this before.
— Buni ilgari ko‘rganman.
2) She has visited Bukhara twice.
— U Buxoroga ikki marta borgan.
3) I saw it yesterday.
— Uni kecha ko‘rdim.
seen-before.en:
I have seen this before describes prior experience connected to now. With a finished time such as yesterday, use past simple for the event.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I have seen this before.
2) She has visited Bukhara twice.
3) I saw it yesterday.

ice.uz:
Break the ice — noqulay yoki yangi suhbatni erkinlashtirish, odamlarni gapga kirishtirish. Bu ibora har doim muz sindirish haqida emas.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) A simple question helped break the ice.
— Oddiy savol suhbatni erkin boshlashga yordam berdi.
2) We played a game to break the ice.
— Tanishib, erkinlashish uchun o‘yin o‘ynadik.
3) Her joke broke the ice.
— Uning hazili noqulaylikni yo‘qotdi.
ice.en:
Break the ice means make a new or awkward social situation more relaxed.

🧩 Three examples:
1) A simple question helped break the ice.
2) We played a game to break the ice.
3) Her joke broke the ice.

blue-moon.uz:
Once in a blue moon — «juda kamdan-kam». Aniq oy sanasini hisoblash emas, odatning kamligini ifodalovchi ibora.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I eat fast food once in a blue moon.
— Tez tayyor ovqatni juda kam yeyman.
2) He visits us once in a blue moon.
— U biznikiga kamdan-kam keladi.
3) We see snow here once in a blue moon.
— Bu yerda qorni juda kam ko‘ramiz.
blue-moon.en:
Once in a blue moon means very rarely, not a precise calendar interval.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I eat fast food once in a blue moon.
2) He visits us once in a blue moon.
3) We see snow here once in a blue moon.

cup-tea.uz:
Not my cup of tea — didimga mos emas, unchalik yoqtirmayman. Bu muloyim shaxsiy afzallik ifodasi; narsani hamma uchun yomon demaydi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Horror films are not my cup of tea.
— Qo‘rqinchli filmlar didimga mos emas.
2) Camping is not really my cup of tea.
— Chodirda dam olishni uncha yoqtirmayman.
3) It’s a good game, but not my cup of tea.
— Yaxshi o‘yin, lekin mening didimga mos emas.
cup-tea.en:
Not my cup of tea means not something I particularly enjoy. It expresses personal preference rather than a universal criticism.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Horror films are not my cup of tea.
2) Camping is not really my cup of tea.
3) It’s a good game, but not my cup of tea.

happy.uz:
Happy, pleased va glad vaziyatga qarab xursandlikni bildiradi. Happy with — natijadan mamnun; glad to hear — yangilikni eshitib xursand.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I’m happy with the result.
— Natijadan mamnunman.
2) I’m glad to hear that.
— Buni eshitganimdan xursandman.
3) She was pleased to see us.
— U bizni ko‘rib xursand bo‘ldi.
happy.en:
Happy, pleased and glad express related feelings with different common patterns.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I’m happy with the result.
2) I’m glad to hear that.
3) She was pleased to see us.

shop.uz:
Narx so‘rashda sodda, muloyim savol yetarli. Suhbatni boshlaymiz: Shop assistant: Hello! How can I help you? Siz xaridor sifatida javob yozishingiz mumkin.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) How much is this?
— Bu qancha turadi?
2) Do you have it in a smaller size?
— Buning kichikroq o‘lchami bormi?
3) Could I pay by card?
— Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi?
shop.en:
Use a simple polite question when shopping. Role-play: Shop assistant: Hello! How can I help you? Reply as the customer.

🧩 Three examples:
1) How much is this?
2) Do you have it in a smaller size?
3) Could I pay by card?

restaurant.uz:
Qisqa suhbat: Waiter: Are you ready to order? Customer: Yes, please. Could I have the vegetable soup? Waiter: Certainly. Anything to drink? Customer: Water, please.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Could I see the menu, please?
— Menyuni ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi?
2) Does this contain nuts?
— Bunda yong‘oq bormi?
3) Could we have the bill, please?
— Hisobni bersangiz.
restaurant.en:
Mini-dialogue: Waiter: Are you ready to order? Customer: Yes, please. Could I have the vegetable soup? Waiter: Certainly. Anything to drink? Customer: Water, please.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Could I see the menu, please?
2) Does this contain nuts?
3) Could we have the bill, please?

hotel.uz:
Qisqa suhbat: Guest: I’d like to book a room for two nights. Receptionist: For how many people? Guest: Two adults. Receptionist: Which dates? Guest: From Friday to Sunday. Bu mashq; haqiqiy bron bajarilmadi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Do you have a room available?
— Bo‘sh xonangiz bormi?
2) Is breakfast included?
— Nonushta narxga kiradimi?
3) What time is check-out?
— Xonani soat nechada topshirish kerak?
hotel.en:
Mini-dialogue: Guest: I’d like to book a room for two nights. Receptionist: For how many people? Guest: Two adults. Receptionist: Which dates? Guest: From Friday to Sunday. This is language practice, not a real reservation.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Do you have a room available?
2) Is breakfast included?
3) What time is check-out?

airport.uz:
Aeroportda xodimdan qisqa va aniq so‘rang. Mashq: Staff member: Hello. Where are you travelling today? Siz yo‘lovchi sifatida javob yozing; men haqiqiy reys yoki darvozani tekshirmayapman.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Where is the check-in desk?
— Ro‘yxatdan o‘tish joyi qayerda?
2) How do I get to gate twelve?
— O‘n ikkinchi chiqish darvozasiga qanday boraman?
3) Could you help me find the baggage claim?
— Yuk olish joyini topishga yordam bera olasizmi?
airport.en:
Ask staff a short, clear question. Role-play: Staff member: Hello. Where are you travelling today? Reply as the passenger. I am not checking real flight or gate information.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Where is the check-in desk?
2) How do I get to gate twelve?
3) Could you help me find the baggage claim?

introduction.uz:
Tanishtiruvni hozirgi faoliyat + tegishli tajriba + maqsad bilan tuzing. Tajribani o‘ylab topmang. O‘zingizga mos ma’lumot bilan quyidagi namunani o‘zgartiring.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I’m a student interested in software development.
— Dastur yaratishga qiziqadigan talabaman.
2) I built a small website as a practice project.
— Mashq loyihasi sifatida kichik sayt yaratdim.
3) I’d like to improve my skills by working with a team.
— Jamoada ishlab ko‘nikmalarimni oshirmoqchiman.
introduction.en:
Structure an introduction as current activity, relevant experience and goal. Replace the sample with truthful personal details.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I’m a student interested in software development.
2) I built a small website as a practice project.
3) I’d like to improve my skills by working with a team.

email.uz:
Rasmiy xatda murojaat, maqsad va so‘rov aniq bo‘ladi. Do‘stona xatda ohang erkinroq, lekin maqsad baribir tushunarli bo‘lsin. Ism yoki vaziyatni o‘ylab topmay, andazadagi joyni o‘zingiz to‘ldiring.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Dear Ms Karimova, I am writing to ask about the course.
— Hurmatli Karimova xonim, kurs haqida so‘ramoqchiman.
2) Could you let me know when the lesson starts?
— Dars qachon boshlanishini ayta olasizmi?
3) Hi Ali, thanks for your message!
— Salom Ali, xabaring uchun rahmat!
email.en:
A formal email needs an appropriate greeting, clear purpose and polite request. Friendly emails can be more relaxed. Replace placeholders with real details.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Dear Ms Karimova, I am writing to ask about the course.
2) Could you let me know when the lesson starts?
3) Hi Ali, thanks for your message!

informal-contractions.uz:
Gonna va wanna norasmiy nutqdagi qisqargan shakllar; rasmiy yozuvda going to va want to ishlating. Gonna asosan reja/kelajakdagi going to + fe’l o‘rnida; har qanday going to’ni almashtirmaydi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I’m going to study tonight.
— Bugun kechqurun o‘qimoqchiman.
2) I want to ask a question.
— Savol bermoqchiman.
3) I’m going to school.
— Maktabga ketyapman; bu joyga borish ma’nosi.
informal-contractions.en:
Gonna and wanna represent informal speech forms. Use going to and want to in formal writing. Gonna does not replace every occurrence of going to, especially a destination phrase.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I’m going to study tonight.
2) I want to ask a question.
3) I’m going to school.

small-talk.uz:
Yengil suhbatda savol + javobga qiziqish + o‘zingizdan qisqa fikr ishlating. Muloyim rozi bo‘lmaslikda odamni emas, fikrni muhokama qiling.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) How has your week been?
— Haftangiz qanday o‘tyapti?
2) That sounds interesting. How did you start?
— Qiziq ekan. Qanday boshlagansiz?
3) I see your point, but I have a different view.
— Fikringizni tushundim, ammo boshqacha qarashim bor.
small-talk.en:
For small talk, ask, respond with interest and add a brief detail. In disagreement, address the idea rather than attacking the person.

🧩 Three examples:
1) How has your week been?
2) That sounds interesting. How did you start?
3) I see your point, but I have a different view.

translation-input.uz: Tarjima qilish kerak bo‘lgan maqol yoki matnning o‘zini yuboring. Ma’no, ohang va vaziyatni saqlashga harakat qilamiz; aynan mos maqol bo‘lmasa, mazmuniy tarjimani alohida aytaman. Matn berilmaganida uning tarjimasini o‘ylab topmayman.
translation-input.en: Share the actual proverb or text. We can preserve meaning, tone and context; if there is no exact equivalent, I will distinguish a meaning-based translation. I cannot translate text that was not supplied.

ten-questions.uz:
Mana kundalik mashq uchun o‘nta savol 🙂
1) What time do you get up?
2) How do you get to school or work?
3) What do you usually have for breakfast?
4) What are you studying now?
5) What did you do yesterday?
6) What do you enjoy doing?
7) Who do you spend time with?
8) What would you like to learn?
9) What are your plans for tomorrow?
10) Why is that important to you?
Birinchi savolga ikki-uch gap bilan javob bering.
ten-questions.en: Ten everyday practice questions: 1) What time do you get up? 2) How do you get to school or work? 3) What do you usually have for breakfast? 4) What are you studying now? 5) What did you do yesterday? 6) What do you enjoy doing? 7) Who do you spend time with? 8) What would you like to learn? 9) What are your plans for tomorrow? 10) Why is that important to you? Start with two or three sentences answering the first.

small-habit.uz: Rejani kichik va tekshiriladigan qiling: bugun bitta muhim ishni tanlang, boshlash vaqtini yozing va 10–15 daqiqalik birinchi qadam belgilang. Masalan, «inglizchani yaxshilayman» o‘rniga «soat 19:00 da beshta so‘zni yopiq holda eslab, uchta gap yozaman». Oxirida nima bajarildi va qaysi to‘siq bo‘lganini qayd eting; ertangi hajmni shunga moslang. Qat’iy bitta jadval hammaga mos emas.
small-habit.en: Make the plan small and observable: choose one priority, schedule a start time and define a ten-to-fifteen-minute first step. Replace improve my English with recall five words and write three sentences at 19:00. Record what you completed and what blocked you, then adjust tomorrow. No single schedule suits everyone.

pomodoro.uz: Bir vazifaga qisqa vaqt ajrating: masalan, 25 daqiqa ishlash va 5 daqiqa tanaffus. Shu orada bildirishnomalarni chetga qo‘yib, faqat bitta aniq ishni bajaring. Bu majburiy 25/5 qonuni emas; diqqat va vazifaga qarab qisqartiring. Taymer tugaganda bajarganingizni tekshiring, faqat vaqt o‘tganini emas.
pomodoro.en: Try a focused block, such as twenty-five minutes of work followed by a five-minute break. Silence distractions and define one task. The 25/5 pattern is an adjustable technique, not a universal rule. Check what you produced, not just how much time elapsed.

explain-back.uz: Mavzuni o‘qib bo‘lgach, kitobni yopib o‘z so‘zingiz bilan tushuntiring. Tushuntirishdagi bo‘sh joyni topib, aynan shu qismini tekshiring. Konspektda chapga savollar, o‘ngga qisqa dalil va misollar, pastga xulosa yozish mumkin. Bir nechta materialni yig‘ishdan ko‘ra bitta qoidani yangi vaziyatda ishlata olishni sinang.
explain-back.en: After studying, close the material and explain it in your own words. Identify a gap, check that part and explain again. Notes can put questions on the left, evidence/examples on the right and a summary below. Test application in a new situation rather than merely collecting sources.

two-languages.uz: Ikki tilni parallel o‘rganish mumkin, lekin har biriga alohida vaqt va aniq maqsad bering. Bir xil yangi so‘zlarni chalkashtirsangiz, mashq kunlari yoki kontekstlarini ajrating. Bir haftadan keyin har ikkala tilda mustaqil nima qila olganingizni tekshirib, vaqtni qayta taqsimlang.
two-languages.en: You can study two languages alongside each other, with separate time blocks and goals. If new items become confused, separate practice days or contexts. Review what you can independently do in each language after a week and adjust the balance.

exam-preparation.uz: Avval imtihon talabi va o‘zingiz xato qilayotgan vazifa turini aniqlang. Bitta kichik mashqni vaqt bilan bajaring, xatoni «bilim», «savolni tushunish», «vaqt» yoki «format» deb belgilang, keyin shu sababga mos mashq qiling. Oxirgi kunlarda faqat yangi mavzu yig‘mang: xatolarni takrorlang va jihoz/jadvalni tekshiring. Bitta past natija butun qobiliyatingizni belgilamaydi.
exam-preparation.en: Identify the test requirements and the task causing trouble. Do a short timed practice, classify errors as knowledge, understanding, time or format, then target the cause. Near the test, review recurring errors and check logistics rather than only adding new topics. One low result does not define your overall ability.

music.uz: Musiqaning ta’siri odam va vazifaga bog‘liq. Ayniqsa matn o‘qishda so‘zli musiqa chalg‘itishi mumkin. Bir xil murakkablikdagi ikki qisqa vazifani jimlikda va musiqa bilan bajarib, tezlik hamda xatoni solishtiring; faqat yoqqaniga qarab hukm qilmang.
music.en: The effect depends on the person and task; lyrics can compete with verbal work. Compare two similar short tasks in quiet and with music, checking both time and errors rather than preference alone.

rest.uz: Charchoqni darrov «dangasalik» deb baholamang. Qisqa tanaffus, muntazam uyqu va o‘zingizga mos yengil harakat o‘qish tartibini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi. Ovqatlanish yoki mashq bo‘yicha shaxsiy tashxis va qat’iy me’yor bera olmayman; ehtiyoj yosh, sog‘liq va sharoitga bog‘liq. Kuchli yoki davomli alomat bo‘lsa malakali tibbiy yordamga murojaat qiling.
rest.en: Do not label fatigue as laziness. Short breaks, regular sleep and suitable light activity can support a study routine. I cannot diagnose symptoms or prescribe an individual diet, exercise dose or fluid target; needs vary by health, age and circumstances. Persistent or severe symptoms need qualified medical advice.

communication.uz: Avval vaziyatni bahosiz ayting, keyin ta’siri va aniq iltimosni yozing. Masalan: «Vazifa o‘zgarganini kech bildim, vaqtim yetmadi. Keyingi safar oldinroq ayta olasizmi?» Qarshi tomonni tinglang va tushunganingizni qisqa qaytaring. Rad etishda «Hozir bunga ulgurmayman, lekin ertaga ko‘rib chiqaman» kabi aniq chegara qo‘ying.
communication.en: Describe what happened without insults, explain the impact and make a concrete request. For example: I learned about the change late and could not finish; could you tell me earlier next time? Listen and briefly confirm what you understood. A polite refusal can set a clear limit and offer a realistic alternative.

shopping-plan.uz: Avval mavjud narsalarni tekshiring. Ro‘yxatni zarur, keyinga qolishi mumkin va ixtiyoriy qismlarga ajrating; miqdor va budjet yozing. Ovqat rejasi uchun bir xil mahsulotdan bir nechta sodda taom rejalash mumkin. Shaxsiy ro‘yxatingizni yuborsangiz, undagi narsalarni tartiblaymiz; ko‘rmagan ro‘yxatni allaqachon saraladim demayman.
shopping-plan.en: Check what you already have, then separate essentials, deferrable items and optional purchases, with quantities and a budget. Shared ingredients can simplify meal planning. Share your actual list for sorting; I cannot claim to have organised an unseen one.

recipe-ratio.uz: Yangi porsiya sonini eski porsiya soniga bo‘ling va har ingredient miqdorini shu koeffitsiyentga ko‘paytiring. Masalan, ikki kishilik retseptni to‘rt kishiga: 4÷2=2; 200 g guruch → 400 g. Pishirish vaqti ham aynan ikki baravar bo‘ladi deb taxmin qilmang; idish va tayyorlikni tekshirish kerak.
recipe-ratio.en: Divide the new serving count by the original, then multiply ingredient quantities by that factor. For two servings changed to four, the factor is 2: 200 g rice becomes 400 g. Cooking time does not automatically double; check the vessel and doneness.

travel-checklist.uz: Safar uchun manzil, sana, yo‘l va qaytish variantini, budjetni, hujjat talablarini va bog‘lanish rejasini tekshiring. Ish vaqti, chipta narxi, ob-havo va kirish qoidalari o‘zgaradi; ularni ketishdan oldin rasmiy xizmatdan tekshiring. Qaysi shahar, necha kun va qanday cheklov borligini yozsangiz, taxminlarni belgilagan holda reja tuzamiz.
travel-checklist.en: Check destination, dates, outbound/return transport, budget, documents and a contact plan. Opening times, fares, weather and entry requirements change, so verify them with the relevant official service before travelling. Share the city, duration and constraints for a plan with explicit assumptions.

digital-security.uz: Shubhali havolani ochishdan oldin domen va jo‘natuvchini mustaqil tekshiring. Shoshiltirish, pul yoki tasdiqlash kodi so‘rash xavf belgisi. Kod, parol va tokenni yubormang; rasmiy ilova/saytni o‘zingiz oching. Men havolani xavfsizlik skanerida tekshirganimni ayta olmayman. Yo‘qolgan qurilma yoki begona kirishda rasmiy sessiya va tiklash boshqaruvidan foydalaning.
digital-security.en: Verify the domain and sender independently before following a suspicious link. Urgency, payment demands and requests for verification codes are warning signs. Do not share secrets; open the official app or site yourself. I have not scanned the link. Use official session and recovery controls for a lost device or suspected intrusion.

home-tech.uz: Avval muammoni ajrating: bitta qurilmadami yoki hammasidami? Internetda boshqa sayt va qurilmani solishtiring; xotirada esa katta fayllar va saqlash ko‘rsatkichini tekshiring. O‘chirishdan oldin zarur fayl nusxasi borligiga ishonch hosil qiling. Elektr qurilmasini ochib ta’mirlash yoki himoya sozlamalarini o‘chirishni tavsiya qilmayman.
home-tech.en: Isolate whether the issue affects one device or all devices. Compare another site/device for connectivity, or inspect storage usage and large files for capacity. Preserve needed files before deleting anything. Do not open electrical equipment or disable security protections as a routine fix.

teacher-plan.uz: Umumiy dars rejasi: 5 daqiqa eski bilimni eslash; 8 daqiqa bitta tushuncha va model; 10 daqiqa yo‘naltirilgan mashq; 10 daqiqa juftlikda mustaqil qo‘llash; 5 daqiqa tekshirish va refleksiya. Uch daraja: tayanch iborali gap, tayanchsiz gap, yangi vaziyatda sababli javob. Feedback’da odamga baho emas, «shu gapda mana bu qoida» deb aniq dalil bering. Uy vazifasi: maqsad + topshiriladigan ish + muddat. Bu tavsiya, darsni tizimga yaratish yoki xabar yuborish amali emas.
teacher-plan.en: A general lesson plan: five minutes retrieval, eight modelling one concept, ten guided practice, ten independent pair work and five review/reflection. Differentiate with a supported sentence, an unsupported sentence and transfer to a new situation. Give evidence about the work rather than labels about the learner. Homework needs a goal, deliverable and deadline. This is a suggested plan, not a created lesson or sent message.

teacher-quiz.uz:
B1 uchun kichik mashq 🙂
1) She has lived here ___ 2020. (since/for)
2) If it rains, we ___ stay home. (will/would)
3) The letter ___ yesterday. (was sent/has sent)
Avval o‘quvchi sababini tushuntirsin. O‘qituvchi kaliti: 1) since — boshlanish nuqtasi; 2) will — real kelajak sharti; 3) was sent — o‘tgan zamon majhul nisbat. Bular yangi, baholanmaydigan misollar.
teacher-quiz.en: A short original practice quiz: 1) She has lived here ___ 2020 (since/for). 2) If it rains, we ___ stay home (will/would). 3) The letter ___ yesterday (was sent/has sent). Ask learners to justify their choices first. Teacher key: since for a starting point; will for a real future condition; was sent for past passive. These are new ungraded examples.

admin-guidance.uz: Ma’muriy ishda eng kam zarur ruxsatni saqlang: haqiqiy sessiya roli, amal vakolati, obyekt doirasi va auditni tekshiring. Teacher biriktirishda aynan qaysi guruh va muddat ekanini tasdiqlang. Akademik matn va ballarni operatsion ro‘yxatga qo‘shmang. Export yoki rol o‘zgartirish tegishli boshqaruv jarayonida bajariladi; chatdagi so‘rov uni bajardi degani emas. Siz aynan qaysi amal bo‘yicha yo‘riqnoma xohlaysiz?
admin-guidance.en: Use least privilege: verify the session role, permitted action, object scope and audit trail. Teacher assignments need an exact group and duration. Keep academic answers and scores out of operational lists. Exports and role changes belong to their authorised management workflow; a chat reply does not perform them. Which action needs guidance?

live-chat.uz: Jonli dars sahifasidagi chatning ko‘rinish va ishtirok qoidalarini tekshiring. Umumiy chatni shaxsiy yozishma deb qabul qilmang: boshqalar ko‘rishi mumkin. Maxfiy ma’lumot kiritmang, savolni dars mavzusiga bog‘lab qisqa yozing. Men hozirgi dars chatini ko‘rganimni yoki xabar yuborganimni ayta olmayman.
live-chat.en: Check the live lesson’s chat visibility and participation rules. Treat a shared chat as visible to others rather than private. Leave out sensitive information and ask a brief question related to the lesson. I have not inspected the current chat or sent a message.

own-report.uz: O‘z natijangiz bo‘yicha yordam uchun akkauntga kirgan bo‘lishingiz va aynan o‘zingizga tegishli ruxsatli urinish tanlangan bo‘lishi kerak. Natija yoki progress bo‘limini oching. Bu javobdan hali shaxsiy hisobot o‘qilgani kelib chiqmaydi; kerakli ma’lumot bo‘lmasa uni o‘ylab topmayman.
own-report.en: Your results require a valid session and an authorised attempt belonging to you. Open the result or progress section. This reply does not mean a personal report has already been read; missing data will not be invented.

tech-701.uz: Maqsadga qarab tanlang: web sahifa uchun HTML/CSS va JavaScript; avtomatlashtirish uchun Python bilan kichik loyiha boshlash mumkin. Bir vaqtda ko‘p til emas, o‘zgaruvchi, shart, sikl, funksiya va xatoni tekshirishni o‘rganing.
tech-701.en: Choose by goal: HTML/CSS and JavaScript for web pages, or Python for a small automation project. Focus on variables, conditions, loops, functions and debugging rather than collecting languages.

tech-702.uz: Python — o‘qilishi qulay sintaksisli, umumiy maqsadli til. Avtomatlashtirish, web va ma’lumot tahlilida ishlatiladi. Mashhurlikning o‘zi har loyiha uchun eng yaxshi tanlov degani emas.
tech-702.en: Python is a general-purpose language with readable syntax, used for automation, web work and data analysis. Popularity does not make it the best choice for every project.

tech-703.uz: HTML hujjat tuzilishi va mazmunini belgilovchi markup tili. CSS uning ko‘rinishi va joylashuvini ifodalaydi. Ular JavaScript kabi umumiy maqsadli dasturlash tili bilan bir vazifani bajarmaydi.
tech-703.en: HTML describes document structure and content; CSS describes presentation and layout. They serve different roles from a general-purpose programming language such as JavaScript.

tech-704.uz: JavaScript brauzerda tugma, forma va boshqa interaktiv harakatlarni boshqaradi; mos runtime bilan serverda ham ishlaydi. Misol: forma tekshirish, ma’lumot so‘rash va javobni sahifada chiqarish.
tech-704.en: JavaScript controls interactive browser behaviour and can run on servers with a suitable runtime. Examples include validating a form, requesting data and updating the page.

tech-705.uz: Frontend — foydalanuvchi ko‘radigan interfeys. Backend — serverdagi qoidalar, ruxsat va ma’lumot bilan ishlash. Tugmani yashirish backend ruxsat tekshiruvining o‘rnini bosmaydi.
tech-705.en: Frontend is the user-facing interface; backend handles server rules, permissions and data. Hiding a button is not a substitute for server authorisation.

tech-706.uz: API — dasturlar o‘rtasida kelishilgan so‘rov-javob chegarasi. Masalan, ob-havo ilovasi shahar kodi bilan so‘rov beradi, xizmat belgilangan shaklda javob qaytaradi. API ruxsatsiz hamma ma’lumotni ochadi degani emas.
tech-706.en: An API is an agreed interface between programs. A weather app might request a city’s forecast and receive a structured response. An API does not imply unrestricted data access.

tech-707.uz: REST — resurslar va ularning holati atrofida tuziladigan arxitektura uslubi. HTTP API’da URL resursni, metod amalni, status esa natijani bildirishi mumkin. Har JSON endpoint avtomatik to‘liq REST bo‘lavermaydi.
tech-707.en: REST is an architectural style organised around resources and representations. In an HTTP API, a URL may identify a resource, a method the action, and a status the result. JSON alone does not make an API RESTful.

tech-708.uz: GET resurs ko‘rinishini olish uchun; uning semantikasi server holatini o‘zgartirmasligi kerak. POST resursga ma’lumotni qayta ishlash uchun yuboradi. GET manzilidagi parametrga sir yozmang; POST ham o‘z-o‘zidan shifrlash emas.
tech-708.en: GET retrieves a representation and is intended to be safe. POST submits data for processing. Do not place secrets in URLs; POST itself is not encryption.

tech-709.uz: 404 — so‘ralgan resurs topilmadi. 500 — server so‘rovni bajarishda kutilmagan xatoga uchradi. Status sababni to‘liq ko‘rsatmaydi: vaqt, request ID va xavfsiz diagnostika kerak.
tech-709.en: 404 means the requested resource was not found; 500 means an unexpected server error prevented fulfilment. The status alone does not establish the root cause; use safe diagnostics and a request ID.

tech-710.uz: FastAPI — Python’da API yaratish frameworki. Tur annotatsiyalari bilan kirish ma’lumotini tekshirish va API sxemasini yaratishga yordam beradi. Baribir autentifikatsiya, ruxsat va testlarni o‘zingiz to‘g‘ri loyihalashingiz kerak.
tech-710.en: FastAPI is a Python framework for building APIs, using type annotations for validation and API schemas. Authentication, authorisation and tests still need sound design.

tech-711.uz: Django yaxlit web ilova uchun ORM va admin kabi ko‘p tayyor qismlarni beradi. FastAPI ko‘proq API markazli ishga mos tuzilma beradi. Tanlov mavjud loyiha, jamoa, ma’lumot modeli va operatsion talabga bog‘liq.
tech-711.en: Django offers an integrated web framework with components such as an ORM and admin interface. FastAPI centres on APIs. Choose according to the existing stack, team, data model and operational needs.

tech-712.uz: Database ma’lumotni tizimli saqlash, topish va mos ravishda yangilash uchun kerak. Masalan, foydalanuvchi, kurs va urinish alohida yozuvlar bo‘ladi. Ularning bog‘lanishi va ruxsatlari ham loyihalanadi.
tech-712.en: A database stores, retrieves and updates structured records, such as users, courses and attempts. Relationships and access rules are part of the design.

tech-713.uz: SQL — so‘rov tili; odatda relational jadvallar bilan ishlatiladi. NoSQL esa hujjat, key-value yoki boshqa modellar oilasiga aytiladi. Ular «biri tez, biri sekin» degan oddiy qoida bilan ajralmaydi.
tech-713.en: SQL is a query language commonly used with relational tables. NoSQL covers families such as document and key-value databases. The distinction is not simply fast versus slow.

tech-714.uz: PostgreSQL — ochiq kodli relational ma’lumotlar bazasi. Tranzaksiya, cheklovlar va indekslar orqali ma’lumot yaxlitligi hamda so‘rovlarni boshqaradi. Indeks qo‘shishdan oldin haqiqiy so‘rov va rejasini o‘lchang.
tech-714.en: PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database with transactions, constraints and indexes. Measure the real query and plan before assuming an extra index will help.

tech-715.uz: Supabase boshqariladigan PostgreSQL asosida auth, storage va boshqa integratsiya qismlarini beradi. Mijoz interfeysi borligi ma’lumot xavfsizligini o‘zidan-o‘zi ta’minlamaydi; server ruxsatlari va RLS to‘g‘ri sozlanishi kerak. Joriy tarifni jonli tekshirmayman.
tech-715.en: Supabase provides managed PostgreSQL with related auth, storage and integration features. Client access does not itself ensure security; authorisation and RLS must be configured correctly. I am not verifying current plans or prices.

tech-716.uz: Git fayl o‘zgarishlari tarixini yuritadi. GitHub esa repositoryni saqlash va hamkorlik qilish xizmatidir. Commit tarixni qayd etadi; remote’ga push qilish alohida amal.
tech-716.en: Git tracks file history. GitHub hosts repositories and collaboration tools. A commit records a change; pushing it to a remote is a separate action.

tech-717.uz: Commit — tarixdagi saqlangan o‘zgarish nuqtasi. Branch — commitlar zanjiriga ko‘chib boradigan nomli ko‘rsatkich. Branch yangi loyiha nusxasi degani emas.
tech-717.en: A commit records a revision. A branch is a named movable pointer to a line of commits, not necessarily an independent copy of the project.

tech-718.uz: Merge conflict o‘zgarishlarni Git avtomatik birlashtira olmaganda chiqadi. Ikkala tomon maqsadini ko‘rib, yakuniy kodni tuzating va tegishli testni bajaring. Shunchaki bir tomonni tanlash ishlayotgan xulqni yo‘qotishi mumkin.
tech-718.en: A merge conflict occurs when Git cannot combine changes automatically. Understand both intentions, resolve the result and run relevant tests. Blindly taking one side can discard working behaviour.

tech-719.uz: Pull request o‘zgarishni ko‘rib chiqish, test dalili va muhokama uchun chegaradir. Reviewer muammo, natijadagi xulq va xavfni tushunishi kerak. PR ochilgani merge yoki production deploy bajarildi degani emas.
tech-719.en: A pull request provides a review boundary for changes, tests and discussion. Reviewers need the problem, resulting behaviour and risks. An open PR does not mean merge or production deployment occurred.

tech-720.uz: CI o‘zgarishlarni avtomatik yig‘ish va tekshirishga yordam beradi. CD yetkazib berish/deploy jarayonini avtomatlashtirishi mumkin. Yashil tekshiruv barcha qurilma va production holati tekshirildi degani emas.
tech-720.en: CI automates integration checks and builds. CD can automate delivery or deployment. Passing CI does not establish every device or production acceptance condition.

tech-721.uz: Hosting xizmatlarini nomi bilan emas, ilovaning runtime, doimiy jarayon, ma’lumotlar bazasi, hudud va xarajat talabi bilan solishtiring. Joriy limit va narxlarni ularning rasmiy hujjatidan tekshirish kerak; men hozir ularni tekshirmayapman.
tech-721.en: Compare hosting platforms by runtime, long-running processes, data needs, regions and cost rather than brand alone. Current limits and prices require official verification; I am not checking them live.

tech-722.uz: CDN kontentni foydalanuvchiga yaqinroq tarmoq nuqtasidan yetkazishi mumkin. Bu kechikishni kamaytiradi, ammo har javob keshlanmasligi kerak: shaxsiy ma’lumotni umumiy keshga qo‘ymang.
tech-722.en: A CDN can serve content from network locations nearer users. It may reduce latency, but private responses must not accidentally enter a shared cache.

tech-723.uz: Domain — saytning nomli manzili; hosting — uni ishlatadigan hisoblash va saqlash xizmati. Domenning DNS sozlamasi kerakli xizmatga yo‘naltiradi.
tech-723.en: A domain is a named address; hosting supplies the computing and storage running the site. DNS connects the name to the relevant service.

tech-724.uz: DNS domen nomini kerakli yozuvlarga moslaydi. A/AAAA IP manzilga, CNAME boshqa nomga, MX email yo‘nalishiga xizmat qiladi. O‘zgarishlar kesh va TTL sabab darhol hamma joyda ko‘rinmasligi mumkin.
tech-724.en: DNS maps domain names to records. A/AAAA indicate IP addresses, CNAME an alias and MX mail routing. Caches and TTL can delay visibility of changes.

tech-725.uz: Environment variable sozlamani koddan ajratadi: masalan, xizmat manzili yoki maxfiy kalit. Har environment variable sir emas, lekin maxfiy qiymatlarni logga yoki brauzer paketiga chiqarmang.
tech-725.en: An environment variable separates configuration from code. It may hold a service address or secret. Not every variable is secret, but secret values must stay out of logs and browser bundles.

tech-727.uz: Authentication — kimligingizni tekshirish; authorization — aynan nima qilishga ruxsatingiz borligini tekshirish. Login bo‘lish boshqa foydalanuvchining natijasini ko‘rish vakolati bermaydi.
tech-727.en: Authentication verifies identity; authorisation checks what that identity may do. Being logged in does not authorise reading another user’s results.

tech-728.uz: JWT — claimlarni kodlaydigan token formati; imzolangan token yaxlitligini tekshirish mumkin. Oddiy imzolangan JWT payload’i shifrlangan degani emas. Imzo, amal muddati va tegishli issuer/audience tekshirilmasdan role matniga ishonmang.
tech-728.en: JWT encodes claims. A signed token can protect integrity, but its payload is not necessarily encrypted. Verify signatures, expiry and applicable issuer/audience before trusting role claims.

tech-729.uz: Cache avval hisoblangan yoki olingan natijani qayta ishlatib xarajat va kechikishni kamaytiradi. Ammo eskirish, invalidation va foydalanuvchi doirasini to‘g‘ri boshqarish kerak.
tech-729.en: A cache reuses prior results to reduce cost and latency. Staleness, invalidation and user scope still need explicit handling.

tech-730.uz: Rate limiting ma’lum vaqt ichidagi so‘rovlar soni yoki xarajatini cheklaydi. U yuk va suiiste’molni boshqarishga yordam beradi, lekin autentifikatsiya yoki ruxsatni almashtirmaydi.
tech-730.en: Rate limiting bounds requests or cost over time. It helps manage load and abuse but does not replace authentication or authorisation.

tech-731.uz: Python list — elementlari almashtiriladigan ketma-ketlik. Tuple — ketma-ketlik tarkibi o‘zgarmaydigan tur; ichidagi mutable obyekt baribir o‘zgarishi mumkin. Tuple avtomatik chuqur muzlatish emas.
tech-731.en: A Python list is mutable; a tuple’s sequence of references is immutable. A mutable object inside a tuple can still change, so a tuple is not deep freezing.

tech-732.uz: Let va const blok doirasiga ega; const o‘zgaruvchini qayta bog‘lashga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi, obyekt ichini avtomatik muzlatmaydi. Var funksiya doirasida ishlaydi va hoisting xulqi farq qiladi.
tech-732.en: Let and const are block-scoped. Const prevents rebinding, not mutation of an object’s contents. Var is function-scoped and has different hoisting behaviour.

tech-733.uz: Async/await asinxron ish natijasini kutishni o‘qilishi qulay shaklda yozadi. Kutish CPU hisobini avtomatik parallel qilmaydi. Mustaqil ishlar uchun concurrency va xato/tugash tartibini alohida loyihalang.
tech-733.en: Async/await expresses asynchronous waiting clearly. It does not automatically parallelise CPU work. Concurrency and failure/order handling still need deliberate design.

tech-734.uz: Promise — keyinroq muvaffaqiyatli qiymat yoki xato bilan yakunlanadigan asinxron natija ifodasi. Pending, fulfilled yoki rejected holatlari bor. Uni yaratish ishning muvaffaqiyati kafolati emas.
tech-734.en: A Promise represents an eventual asynchronous value or failure, with pending, fulfilled and rejected states. Creating one does not guarantee success.
