tech-735.uz: Unit test kichik xulqni alohida tekshiradi. Integration test qismlarning birga ishlashini tekshiradi. Haqiqiy brauzer, sessiya va ma’lumot oqimi uchun end-to-end dalil ham kerak bo‘lishi mumkin.
tech-735.en: A unit test checks focused behaviour; an integration test checks components working together. Real browser, session and data flows may also need end-to-end evidence.

tech-736.uz: Mock tashqi bog‘liqlik o‘rniga nazorat qilinadigan javob beradi. Xato va chekka holatlarni sinashga qulay, lekin haqiqiy tarmoq yoki database mosligini isbotlamaydi.
tech-736.en: A mock replaces a dependency with controlled behaviour, useful for failures and edge cases. It does not prove real network or database compatibility.

tech-737.uz: Container ilova va bog‘liqliklarni izolyatsiyalangan ishlash muhiti sifatida qadoqlaydi. U virtual mashina bilan bir xil emas va xavfsizlikni avtomatik ta’minlamaydi; image, huquqlar va sirlarni boshqarish muhim.
tech-737.en: Containers package software and dependencies in isolated execution environments. They are not identical to virtual machines and do not ensure security automatically; images, privileges and secrets matter.

tech-738.uz: Virtual environment Python loyihasining paketlarini boshqa loyihalardan ajratadi. U alohida operatsion tizim yoki xavfsizlik sandboxi emas. Bog‘liqlik versiyalarini ham qayd eting.
tech-738.en: A Python virtual environment isolates project packages. It is not a separate operating system or security sandbox. Record dependency versions as well.

tech-739.uz: TypeScript JavaScript’ga statik tip tekshiruvini qo‘shadi. Kattaroq kod bazasida xatoni erta topishga yordam beradi; runtime’dagi begona ma’lumotni baribir tekshirish kerak. Avval JavaScript asoslarini tushunish foydali.
tech-739.en: TypeScript adds static type checking to JavaScript. It can catch mistakes earlier, but untrusted runtime data still needs validation. Understanding JavaScript fundamentals remains useful.

tech-740.uz: Machine learning ma’lumotdan qonuniyat o‘rganadigan usullar oilasi. Deep learning — ko‘p qatlamli neyron tarmoqlarga tayangan qismi. Har ML masalasi katta neyron model talab qilmaydi.
tech-740.en: Machine learning covers methods that learn patterns from data. Deep learning is a subset based on multilayer neural networks. Not every problem needs a large neural model.

tech-741.uz: LLM — katta hajmdagi til ma’lumotlari bilan o‘qitilgan til modeli. U ketma-ketlik asosida matn hosil qiladi; bilim yoki to‘g‘rilikni kafolatlamaydi. RIWI’ning hozirgi qoidaviy mexanizmi LLM o‘qitildi degani emas.
tech-741.en: An LLM is a language model trained on large amounts of text. It generates sequences without guaranteeing correctness. RIWI’s current rule-based mechanism is not an LLM trained by uploading these questions.

tech-742.uz: RAG javobdan oldin tegishli ma’lumotni qidirib, unga tayangan holda javob tayyorlash usulidir. Topilgan matn noto‘g‘ri yoki ruxsatsiz bo‘lsa, natija ham muammoli bo‘ladi; retrievalning o‘zi haqiqat kafolati emas.
tech-742.en: RAG retrieves relevant material before producing an answer. Incorrect or unauthorised retrieved material can still lead to problems; retrieval alone does not establish truth.

tech-743.uz: Chatbot asosan suhbatga javob beradi. Agent maqsad yo‘lida vosita yoki bir necha qadamni boshqarishi mumkin; atamalar doim bir xil ishlatilmaydi. Vosita borligi xavfsiz mustaqil ishlash vakolati bor degani emas.
tech-743.en: A chatbot mainly responds conversationally; an agent may coordinate tools or steps towards a goal. Terminology varies. Tool access does not itself grant unrestricted authority.

tech-744.uz: Yaxshi topshiriqda maqsad, kirish ma’lumoti, cheklov va kutilgan chiqish aniq yoziladi. Natijani bir xil sinov misollarida tekshirib, dalilsiz ishonchni emas, to‘g‘rilikni baholang.
tech-744.en: A useful prompt states the goal, input, constraints and expected output. Evaluate results on consistent examples rather than mistaking confident language for correctness.

tech-745.uz: Hallucination — modelning ishonchli ohangda noto‘g‘ri yoki o‘ylab topilgan ma’lumot berishi. Sana, hisob, havola va muhim da’volarni mustaqil tekshiring. Chiroyli yozilgan javob dalil emas.
tech-745.en: A hallucination is a plausible-looking but false or invented output. Independently check dates, calculations, links and consequential claims. Fluent wording is not evidence.

tech-746.uz: AI javobini vazifa bo‘yicha tekshiring: fakt to‘g‘rimi, savolga mosmi, ruxsat saqlanganmi, yetishmagan ma’lumot tan olinganmi? Oddiy, noaniq, xatoli yozuvli va xavfsizlik misollarini alohida sinang.
tech-746.en: Evaluate factual accuracy, relevance, permissions and handling of missing information. Include normal, ambiguous, misspelled and adversarial cases rather than only easy examples.

tech-749.uz: Kichik xatoni tanlang, loyiha yo‘riqnomasini o‘qing, mavjud testni ishga tushiring va minimal o‘zgarish taklif qiling. PR’da muammo, natijadagi xulq va test dalilini yozing. Hali yubormagan ishni yuborildi deb aytmang.
tech-749.en: Choose a small issue, read the project guidance, run relevant tests and propose a minimal change. Explain the problem, resulting behaviour and validation in the PR. Do not claim an unsubmitted change was sent.

tech-750.uz: Uch oylik namunaviy yo‘l: birinchi oy — til asoslari, Git va kichik CLI; ikkinchi oy — HTTP, API, database va ruxsatlar; uchinchi oy — test, log, deploy va bitta yakuniy loyiha. Haftalik vaqtni aytsangiz hajmni moslash mumkin. Bu ishga kirish kafolati emas.
tech-750.en: An illustrative three-month path: month one language fundamentals, Git and a small CLI; month two HTTP, APIs, databases and permissions; month three tests, logs, deployment and one complete project. Adjust to available weekly time; this is not an employment guarantee.

career-start.uz: Kasb tanlashda qiziqish, mavjud ko‘nikma, haqiqiy vakansiya talabi va o‘rganish imkonini solishtiring; kelajak daromadini kafolatlab bo‘lmaydi. Portfolio’da 1–2 tugallangan loyiha, siz bajargan qism, qarorlar va natijani ko‘rsating. Intervyuda bilmasangiz, taxminni belgilang va qanday tekshirishingizni ayting. Ish qidirishda rasmiy e’lon va ish beruvchi shaxsini tekshiring; ish olish uchun shubhali oldindan to‘lovga rozi bo‘lmang.
career-start.en: Compare interests, existing skills, real job requirements and learning capacity; no future income is guaranteed. A portfolio should show one or two completed projects, your contribution, decisions and evidence. In interviews, distinguish what you know from a hypothesis and explain how you would verify it. Check employers and be cautious about paying to obtain a job.

cv-cover.uz: Resume odatda ma’lum ishga mos qisqa tajriba va natijalar bayoni. CV atamasi mamlakat va sohaga qarab batafsil akademik hujjat yoki resume ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Cover letter’da qaysi rol, nega mosligingiz va bitta aniq dalilni yozing: «I am applying for the junior developer role. In my recent project, I built…» Tajriba va natijani uydirmang.
cv-cover.en: A resume is usually a concise, role-focused account of experience and results. CV usage varies by country and field, from an academic record to a synonym for resume. A cover letter names the role, your fit and specific evidence: I am applying for the junior developer role. In my recent project, I built… Never invent achievements.

business-validation.uz: Avval kimning qaysi muammosini yechayotganingizni aniqlang. Taxminni kichik sinovga aylantiring: suhbat, oddiy prototip yoki bitta cheklangan xizmat. MVP — asosiy taxminni tekshirishga yetadigan eng kichik ishlaydigan yechim; sifatsiz hamma funksiya emas. Mijoz qaytishi, foyda va xizmat xarajatini o‘lchang; faqat maqtov yoki ro‘yxatdan o‘tish yetmaydi.
business-validation.en: Identify the customer and problem, then test one assumption through interviews, a prototype or a small service. An MVP is the smallest usable approach that tests the key assumption, not every feature done poorly. Measure repeat use, value and delivery cost rather than treating compliments or sign-ups as proof of fit.

pricing.uz: Narxni kelishishda ish hajmi, topshiriladigan natija, muddat, tuzatishlar soni va to‘lov shartini yozma aniqlang. Xarajat va yetkazish vaqtini hisoblamasdan faqat raqobatchi narxini ko‘chirmang. Oldindan to‘lov riskni kamaytirishi mumkin, lekin ikki tomon uchun qaytarish va bekor qilish sharti aniq bo‘lsin. Bu shartnoma yoki huquqiy xulosa o‘rnini bosmaydi.
pricing.en: Define scope, deliverables, deadline, revision limits and payment terms in writing. Estimate delivery time and cost rather than copying a competitor’s price. A deposit can reduce risk, but cancellation and refund terms need clarity for both sides. This is general education, not a contract or legal determination.

revenue-profit.uz: Daromad — sotuvdan tushgan summa; foyda — tegishli xarajatlar ayirilgandan qolgan natija. Pul oqimi esa pulning amalda kirishi va chiqishi. Masalan, 1 mln so‘mlik sotuv va 700 ming xarajat — 300 ming foyda; mijoz hali to‘lamagan bo‘lsa, kassada bu pul bo‘lmasligi mumkin.
revenue-profit.en: Revenue is sales income; profit subtracts the relevant costs. Cash flow tracks actual cash receipts and payments. Sales of 1,000 with costs of 700 yield profit of 300, but if the customer has not paid, the cash may not yet be available.

break-even.uz: Oddiy modelda zararsizlik hajmi = doimiy xarajat ÷ (birlik narxi − birlik o‘zgaruvchan xarajati). Masalan, 1 000 000 ÷ (50 000 − 30 000) = 50 birlik. Bu faqat narx va xarajat o‘zgarmas, barcha birlik sotiladi degan farazdagi hisob; haqiqiy biznesda soliq, qaytarish va quvvat cheklovi ham bor.
break-even.en: In a simple model, break-even units equal fixed costs divided by price minus variable cost per unit. For example, 1,000,000 / (50,000 − 30,000) = 50 units. This assumes constant costs/prices and saleable output; real taxes, returns and capacity can alter the result.

budget.uz: Budjetda tasdiqlangan tushum, zarur xarajatlar, o‘zgaruvchan xarajat va kutilmagan holat uchun zaxirani ajrating. Qarzda faqat oylik to‘lov emas, jami qaytarish, komissiya, muddat va daromad kamayishi xavfini ham solishtiring. Hammaga mos qat’iy foiz yoki qarz olish tavsiyasi yo‘q; shaxsiy qaror uchun to‘liq shartlar va malakali maslahat kerak.
budget.en: Separate verified income, essential costs, variable spending and a contingency reserve. For borrowing, compare total repayment, fees, term and income-loss risk, not just the monthly instalment. There is no universal allocation or borrowing recommendation; personal decisions require the full terms and appropriate qualified advice.

inflation.uz: Inflyatsiya narxlarning umumiy darajasi oshishini anglatadi; shu pulga olinadigan mahsulot kamayishi mumkin. Nominal o‘sish bilan xarid qobiliyati bir xil emas. Masalan, pul 5% ko‘payib, narxlar 10% oshsa, real xarid qobiliyati taxminan 1.05/1.10−1 ≈ −4.5% bo‘ladi. Bu misol, joriy inflyatsiya prognozi emas.
inflation.en: Inflation is an increase in the general price level, which can reduce purchasing power. Nominal growth differs from real growth: a 5% balance increase with 10% inflation gives about 1.05/1.10 − 1 = −4.5% real change. This is an illustration, not a current forecast.

compound.uz: Murakkab foizda keyingi davr foizi oldingi foiz qo‘shilgan summaga hisoblanadi. Oddiy formulada A=P(1+r)^n. Masalan, 1 000 birlik, yillik 10%, ikki yil: 1 000×1.1²=1 210. Bu o‘zgarmas stavka, komissiyasiz va soliqsiz misol; haqiqiy mahsulot daromadi kafolati emas.
compound.en: Compound interest applies interest to a balance that includes earlier interest. In a simple model A=P(1+r)^n: 1,000 at 10% annually for two years becomes 1,210. This assumes a fixed rate with no fees or taxes and is not a product-return guarantee.

transparency.uz: Kim nima uchun javobgar, qanday xarajat va natija kutiladi, qaror qanday o‘lchanadi — shularni oldindan yozing. Sheriklikda ulush, vazifa, pul yechish, kelishmovchilik va chiqish tartibini muhokama qiling. Xodim olishda takroriy ish hajmi va uni moliyalashtirish imkonini tekshiring. Umumiy tavsiya shaxsiy huquqiy yoki moliyaviy ekspertiza o‘rnini bosmaydi.
transparency.en: Record responsibilities, costs, expected outcomes and decision measures. Partners should discuss ownership, duties, withdrawals, disputes and exits. Before hiring, verify recurring workload and funding capacity. General guidance does not replace individual legal or financial review.

marketing.uz: Marketing ehtiyoj va auditoriyani tushunib, taklifga qiziqish uyg‘otadi; sotuv esa muayyan kelishuvga olib boradi. Kontent marketing foydali material orqali tegishli auditoriyani jalb qiladi. Kichik sinovda kanal xarajati, sifatli murojaat va haqiqiy sotuvni birga o‘lchang; ko‘rishlar sonining o‘zi foyda emas.
marketing.en: Marketing understands needs and attracts the relevant audience; sales turns an opportunity into an agreement. Content marketing uses useful material to reach that audience. Measure channel cost, qualified enquiries and actual sales together; views alone are not profit.

swot-kpi.uz: SWOT ichki kuchli/zaif tomonlar va tashqi imkoniyat/xavflarni ajratadi. KPI — kuzatiladigan natija ko‘rsatkichi; OKR — maqsad va uni ko‘rsatuvchi asosiy natijalar. Masalan, «xatolarni kamaytirish» maqsadi uchun takroriy xato ulushini haftalik o‘lchash mumkin. Raqamni o‘zi uchun oshirish emas, maqsadga xizmat qilishini tekshiring.
swot-kpi.en: SWOT separates internal strengths/weaknesses from external opportunities/threats. A KPI measures performance; an OKR links an objective to measurable key results. For reducing repeat errors, track their weekly rate. Check whether a metric serves the objective rather than optimising the number alone.

science-801.uz: Foiz «yuzdan ulush» degani. A ning p foizi = A×p/100. Masalan, 80 ning 25 foizi: 80×25/100=20.
science-801.en: Percent means per hundred. p percent of A is A×p/100; for example, 25% of 80 is 20.

science-802.uz: 200 ning 15 foizi 30: 200×15/100=30. Tekshirish: 10 foizi 20, 5 foizi 10; jami 30.
science-802.en: 15% of 200 is 30: 200×15/100. Check: 10% is 20 and 5% is 10, totalling 30.

science-803.uz: Kasrlarni qo‘shishda maxrajni tenglashtiring. 1/2+1/3 = 3/6+2/6 = 5/6. Surat va maxrajni alohida qo‘shish xato.
science-803.en: Use a common denominator: 1/2+1/3=3/6+2/6=5/6. Do not add denominators directly.

science-804.uz: Kasrni o‘nli ko‘rinishga aylantirish uchun suratni maxrajga bo‘ling: 3/4=0.75. Ayrim kasrlar davriy: 1/3=0.333… . Maxraj nol bo‘la olmaydi.
science-804.en: Divide numerator by denominator: 3/4=0.75; some decimals repeat, such as 1/3=0.333… . The denominator cannot be zero.

science-805.uz: Proporsiya ikki nisbat tengligi: a/b=c/d. Nol bo‘lmagan maxrajlarda ad=bc. Masalan, 2/3=4/6.
science-805.en: A proportion equates two ratios: a/b=c/d. With nonzero denominators, ad=bc; for example, 2/3=4/6.

science-806.uz: 3:5 ikki qism nisbatidir: birinchi qism 3 ulush, ikkinchisi 5 ulush. Jami 8 ulush; jami 40 bo‘lsa qismlar 15 va 25.
science-806.en: 3:5 compares two parts, three shares to five. The total is eight shares; a total of 40 splits into 15 and 25.

science-807.uz: Tenglamada ikki tomonga bir xil ruxsatli amalni bajaring. 2x+3=11 → 2x=8 → x=4. Tekshirish: 2×4+3=11.
science-807.en: Apply the same valid operation to both sides: 2x+3=11 gives 2x=8, then x=4. Substitute back to check.

science-808.uz: ax²+bx+c=0 da a≠0 va D=b²−4ac. D>0 — ikkita turli real ildiz; D=0 — bitta takroriy real ildiz; D<0 — real ildiz yo‘q. Kompleks sonlarda yechim bo‘lishi mumkin.
science-808.en: For ax²+bx+c=0 with a≠0, D=b²−4ac. Positive D gives two distinct real roots, zero a repeated real root, and negative D no real roots, though complex roots exist.

science-809.uz: Funksiya har bir ruxsatli kirish qiymatiga aynan bitta chiqish qiymatini moslaydi. Grafik (x,f(x)) nuqtalarini ko‘rsatadi. Masalan, f(x)=2x bo‘lsa x=3 uchun f(3)=6.
science-809.en: A function assigns exactly one output to each allowed input. Its graph shows points (x,f(x)); for f(x)=2x, f(3)=6.

science-810.uz: y=mx+b da m — qiyalik: x bir birlik oshganda y qancha o‘zgaradi. Masalan, y=3x+2 da x 1 ga oshsa y 3 ga oshadi.
science-810.en: In y=mx+b, m is the slope: the change in y per unit change in x. For y=3x+2, y increases by 3 when x increases by 1.

science-811.uz: To‘g‘ri burchakli uchburchakda a²+b²=c²; c — gipotenuza. Katetlar 3 va 4 bo‘lsa c=√(9+16)=5. Bu qoida har qanday uchburchakka shu shaklda tatbiq qilinmaydi.
science-811.en: For a right triangle, a²+b²=c², with c the hypotenuse. Legs 3 and 4 give c=5. This form requires a right angle.

science-812.uz: Uchburchak yuzi asos×shu asosga perpendikulyar balandlik÷2. Asos 8 sm, balandlik 5 sm bo‘lsa yuzi 20 sm².
science-812.en: Triangle area is base times perpendicular height divided by two. A base of 8 cm and height of 5 cm give 20 cm².

science-813.uz: Aylana uzunligi C=2πr=πd. Radius 3 sm bo‘lsa C=6π sm, taxminan 18.85 sm.
science-813.en: Circumference is C=2πr=πd. Radius 3 cm gives 6π cm, about 18.85 cm.

science-814.uz: Radius markazdan aylanagacha masofa; diametr markazdan o‘tib ikki chetni birlashtiradi. Diametr radiusning ikki baravari: d=2r.
science-814.en: A radius runs from centre to circle; a diameter passes through the centre between opposite points. d=2r.

science-815.uz: Kub hajmi V=a³. Qirra 4 sm bo‘lsa V=64 sm³. Hajm birliklari kub birliklarda yoziladi.
science-815.en: Cube volume is V=a³. A 4 cm edge gives 64 cm³; volume uses cubic units.

science-816.uz: O‘rtacha — yig‘indi sonlar soniga bo‘linadi. Mediana — tartiblangan ro‘yxatning o‘rtasi. 1,2,9 da o‘rtacha 4, mediana 2; katta chekka qiymat o‘rtachaga kuchliroq ta’sir qiladi.
science-816.en: The mean is sum divided by count; the median is the middle of ordered values. For 1,2,9, the mean is 4 and median 2. An extreme value affects the mean more strongly.

science-817.uz: Moda — eng ko‘p takrorlangan qiymat. 2,2,3,4 da moda 2. Bir nechta moda yoki barcha qiymat bir xil chastotada bo‘lsa yagona moda bo‘lmasligi mumkin.
science-817.en: The mode is the most frequent value: 2 in 2,2,3,4. Data may have multiple modes or no unique mode.

science-818.uz: Teng ehtimolli natijalarda ehtimollik = qulay natijalar soni ÷ jami natijalar soni. Adolatli kubikda 6 tushish ehtimoli 1/6. Teng ehtimollilik farazini tekshirish kerak.
science-818.en: For equally likely outcomes, probability is favourable outcomes divided by total outcomes. A fair die gives probability 1/6 of rolling a six. The equal-likelihood assumption matters.

science-819.uz: Ikki mustaqil adolatli tangada ikkisi ham gerb: 1/2×1/2=1/4, ya’ni 25%. Natijalar GG, GR, RG, RR; ulardan bittasi GG.
science-819.en: For two independent fair coins, both heads has probability 1/2×1/2=1/4=25%. Of HH, HT, TH, TT, only HH qualifies.

science-820.uz: Permutatsiyada tartib muhim; kombinatsiyada tanlangan guruh muhim, tartib emas. A,B dan AB va BA ikki tartib, lekin bitta ikki kishilik guruh.
science-820.en: Permutations distinguish order; combinations do not. AB and BA are two arrangements but the same two-member group.

science-821.uz: logₐ(b)=c degani aᶜ=b. Masalan, log₂(8)=3, chunki 2³=8. Real logarifm uchun asos a>0, a≠1 va b>0.
science-821.en: logₐ(b)=c means aᶜ=b. For example, log₂8=3 because 2³=8. For real logs, a>0, a≠1 and b>0.

science-822.uz: Hosila funksiyaning nuqtadagi o‘zgarish tezligini, grafikda urinma qiyaligini bildiradi. f(x)=x² uchun f′(x)=2x; x=3 da qiyalik 6.
science-822.en: A derivative measures local rate of change or tangent slope. For f(x)=x², f′(x)=2x, so the slope at x=3 is 6.

science-823.uz: Integral uzluksiz miqdorlarni yig‘ish g‘oyasidir. Aniq integral ishorali maydon yoki o‘zgarishdan jami miqdorni topishi mumkin. Masalan, doimiy tezlikni vaqt bo‘yicha integrallash masofani beradi.
science-823.en: Integration accumulates continuous quantities. A definite integral can give signed area or total change; integrating constant speed over time gives distance.

science-824.uz: Vaqt murakkabligi kirish hajmi oshganda amallar soni qanday o‘sishini tasvirlaydi. Ro‘yxatni bir marta ko‘rish odatda O(n); har bir elementni har biri bilan solishtirish O(n²) bo‘lishi mumkin. Bu aniq millisekund emas.
science-824.en: Time complexity describes growth in operations with input size. One traversal is typically O(n); comparing every pair may be O(n²). It is not an exact millisecond prediction.

science-825.uz: Premissa — xulosa chiqarishda asos sifatida olingan gap. Mantiqan to‘g‘ri shaklning o‘zi premissalar fakt sifatida to‘g‘riligini isbotlamaydi.
science-825.en: A premise is a statement used to support a conclusion. A valid inference form does not itself prove its premises are factually true.

science-826.uz: Yo‘q. Barcha A lar B bo‘lishi barcha B lar A degani emas. Masalan, barcha mushuklar hayvon, ammo barcha hayvonlar mushuk emas.
science-826.en: No. All A being B does not imply all B are A. All cats are animals, but not all animals are cats.

science-827.uz: Paradoks — bir qarashda asosli fikrlardan qarama-qarshi yoki kutilmagan natija chiqishi. Bu ta’rif, faraz yoki mantiqdagi yashirin muammoni tekshirishga undaydi.
science-827.en: A paradox is an apparently contradictory or surprising result from seemingly reasonable reasoning. It invites examination of assumptions, definitions or logic.

science-828.uz: Korrelyatsiya ikki miqdorning birga o‘zgarishi; sababiyat biri ikkinchisiga ta’sir qilishidir. Muzqaymoq va cho‘milish ko‘payishi issiq ob-havo bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin; biri boshqasini keltirib chiqardi degani emas.
science-828.en: Correlation is co-variation; causation means one factor influences another. Ice-cream sales and swimming may both rise in hot weather without one causing the other.

science-829.uz: Inersial sanoq sistemasida natijaviy kuch nol bo‘lsa, jism tinch yoki o‘zgarmas tezlik bilan to‘g‘ri chiziqli harakatda qoladi. Kuch yo‘qligi harakat ham yo‘q degani emas.
science-829.en: In an inertial frame, zero net force means rest or uniform straight-line motion. No net force does not imply no motion.

science-830.uz: O‘zgarmas massa uchun Nyutonning ikkinchi qonuni F=ma: natijaviy kuch massa va tezlanish ko‘paytmasi. 2 kg jismga 6 N net kuch ta’sir etsa, a=3 m/s².
science-830.en: For constant mass, Newton’s second law is F=ma. A net force of 6 N on 2 kg gives acceleration 3 m/s².

science-831.uz: Yopiq tizimda jami energiya saqlanadi, ammo shakli o‘zgaradi. Masalan, tushayotgan jismning potensial energiyasi kinetik energiyaga, ishqalanishda esa issiqlikka aylanadi.
science-831.en: Total energy in a closed system is conserved while changing form. Falling converts potential to kinetic energy; friction transfers energy into thermal forms.

science-832.uz: Quyosh nuri atmosferada sochiladi. Qisqaroq ko‘k to‘lqinlar uzunroq qizil to‘lqinlarga qaraganda kuchliroq sochilgani uchun osmon ko‘pincha ko‘k ko‘rinadi. Bu dengiz rangining oddiy aksi emas.
science-832.en: Sunlight scatters in the atmosphere. Shorter blue wavelengths scatter more strongly than longer red wavelengths, making much of the daytime sky appear blue. It is not simply an ocean reflection.

science-833.uz: Tezlik masofa/vaqt bilan o‘lchanadi: SI birligi m/s. Vakuumdagi yorug‘lik tezligi aniq 299 792 458 m/s. Moddadagi tarqalish tezligi bundan boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin.
science-833.en: Speed is distance per time, measured in m/s in SI. Light in vacuum travels at exactly 299,792,458 m/s; propagation in a material can differ.

science-834.uz: Oddiy tovush mexanik tebranish bo‘lib, tarqalishi uchun muhit kerak. Ideal vakuumda u tarqalmaydi. Elektromagnit to‘lqinlar esa vakuumda tarqala oladi.
science-834.en: Ordinary sound is a mechanical disturbance requiring a medium and does not propagate through an ideal vacuum. Electromagnetic waves can travel through vacuum.

science-835.uz: Atom kimyoviy elementning xususiyatini saqlovchi birlik. Molekula bog‘langan atomlardan tuzilgan birlik. Masalan, suv molekulasi ikki vodorod va bitta kislorod atomidan iborat.
science-835.en: An atom is a unit of a chemical element; a molecule consists of bonded atoms. A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

science-836.uz: Elektr toki — zaryad oqimi, amperda o‘lchanadi. Kuchlanish — birlik zaryadga to‘g‘ri keladigan potensial energiya farqi, voltda. Ularni bir xil kattalik deb qabul qilmang.
science-836.en: Current is the rate of charge flow, measured in amperes. Voltage is electric potential difference, measured in volts. They are different quantities.

science-837.uz: Kislota va asos xossalari indikator yoki mos o‘lchov bilan tekshiriladi. Noma’lum moddani tatib ko‘rish yoki uyda aralashtirib sinash xavfli. Tajriba faqat xavfsiz laboratoriya tartibida bajariladi.
science-837.en: Acid/base properties can be checked with suitable indicators or measurement. Never taste or casually mix unknown chemicals. Experiments require an appropriate safety procedure.

science-838.uz: pH eritmaning kislotaliligini ifodalaydi; vodorod ionlari faolligi bilan logarifmik bog‘liq. Suyultirilgan suvli eritmada 25°C atrofida pH 7 neytral, pastrog‘i kislotali, yuqorirog‘i asosli. Sharoit muhim.
science-838.en: pH is a logarithmic measure related to hydrogen-ion activity. For dilute aqueous solutions around 25°C, pH 7 is neutral, lower values acidic and higher values basic. Conditions matter.

science-839.uz: Fotosintezda o‘simlik, suvo‘t va ayrim bakteriyalar yorug‘lik energiyasini kimyoviy energiyaga aylantiradi. O‘simliklarda karbonat angidrid va suvdan organik modda hosil bo‘lib, kislorod ajraladi.
science-839.en: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy. In plants, carbon dioxide and water contribute to organic compounds while oxygen is released.

science-840.uz: Yadro eukariot hujayrada DNKning katta qismini saqlaydi va gen ifodasi orqali faoliyatni boshqarishda qatnashadi. Barcha hujayralarda yadro bor emas; bakteriyalarda membranali yadro yo‘q.
science-840.en: The nucleus stores most DNA in eukaryotic cells and participates in regulating activity through gene expression. Not all cells have one; bacteria lack a membrane-bound nucleus.

science-841.uz: DNK odatda irsiy ma’lumotni uzoqroq saqlaydi; RNK uning ifodalanishi va oqsil sintezi kabi ishlarda qatnashadi. DNKda dezoksiriboza va timin, RNKda riboza va uratsil bo‘ladi; shaklida istisnolar bor.
science-841.en: DNA usually stores hereditary information; RNA participates in expression and protein synthesis among other roles. DNA contains deoxyribose and thymine; RNA ribose and uracil. Structural exceptions exist.

science-842.uz: Evolyutsiya — populyatsiyalardagi irsiy xususiyatlar avlodlar davomida o‘zgarishi. Tabiiy tanlanish, mutatsiya, gen oqimi va genetik drift kabi jarayonlar qatnashadi; alohida odamning umr davomida mashq bilan o‘zgarishi bilan bir xil emas.
science-842.en: Evolution is change in inherited characteristics of populations over generations through processes including selection, mutation, gene flow and drift. It is not the same as an individual improving through practice.

science-843.uz: Immun tizimi begona omillarni tanish va ularga javob berishda qatnashuvchi hujayra hamda molekulalar tizimidir. Tug‘ma va orttirilgan javoblar hamkorlik qiladi. Bu umumiy ta’rif, shaxsiy kasallik yoki davolash bo‘yicha tashxis emas.
science-843.en: The immune system uses cells and molecules to recognise and respond to threats. Innate and adaptive responses work together. This is a general definition, not individual diagnosis or treatment advice.

science-844.uz: Quyosh tortishishi sayyora harakati yo‘nalishini egadi, uning harakati esa orbitada davom etadi. Orbitani «tortishish yo‘q» deb tushunish xato; u erkin tushishning bir shakli.
science-844.en: Solar gravity continuously curves planetary motion into an orbit. Orbiting does not mean gravity is absent; it is a form of free fall.

science-845.uz: Oy doim taxminan yarim yoritilgan, ammo Yerga ko‘rinadigan yoritilgan qism uning orbitadagi holati bilan o‘zgaradi. Odatdagi fazalar Yer soyasi sababli emas; Yer soyasi Oy tutilishida qatnashadi.
science-845.en: About half the Moon is illuminated; the fraction of that lit half visible from Earth changes with orbital position. Ordinary phases are not caused by Earth’s shadow, which matters during a lunar eclipse.

science-846.uz: Qora tuynuk — fazo-vaqtning voqea gorizonti ichidan yorug‘lik ham tashqariga chiqa olmaydigan sohasi. Uni hamma narsani har qanday masofadan so‘rib oladigan oddiy changyutgich deb tasvirlash to‘g‘ri emas.
science-846.en: A black hole is a region whose event horizon prevents even light from escaping outward. It is not a vacuum cleaner that pulls in everything at any distance.

science-847.uz: Ob-havo — qisqa muddatdagi atmosfera holati. Iqlim — uzoq davrdagi statistik xususiyatlar va o‘zgaruvchanlik. Bir kunning sovuqligi uzoq muddatli global yo‘nalishni inkor qilmaydi.
science-847.en: Weather is the short-term atmospheric state; climate concerns long-term statistics and variability. One cold day does not disprove a long-term global trend.

science-848.uz: Hozirgi global isishning asosiy omili inson faoliyati, ayniqsa qazilma yoqilg‘i va yer foydalanishi bilan bog‘liq issiqxona gazlaridir. Gazlar Yerning chiqayotgan issiqligini ushlab qolish jarayoniga ta’sir qiladi.
science-848.en: The main driver of current global warming is human activity, especially greenhouse-gas emissions linked to fossil fuels and land use. These gases affect the escape of outgoing heat.

science-849.uz: Ilmiy nazariya ko‘p dalil bilan asoslangan tushuntirish tizimi; «shunchaki taxmin» emas. Gipoteza — tekshirish mumkin bo‘lgan taklif. Ikkalasi ham yangi dalilga qarab qayta baholanadi.
science-849.en: A scientific theory is a well-supported explanatory framework, not merely a guess. A hypothesis is a testable proposal. Both are assessed against evidence.

science-850.uz: Da’voni o‘lchanadigan taxminga aylantiring, nazorat va taqqoslash shartini belgilang, oldindan natija mezonini yozing va tajribani takrorlang. Bitta tasodifiy natija umumiy sababni isbotlamaydi.
science-850.en: Turn a claim into a measurable prediction, define controls and comparison, state outcome criteria in advance and repeat the test. A single chance result does not establish a general cause.

history-901.uz: O‘zbekiston poytaxti — Toshkent. U Toshkent viloyatidan alohida ma’muriy birlik bo‘lgan shahardir.
history-901.en: Uzbekistan’s capital is Tashkent, a city administratively separate from Tashkent Region.

history-902.uz: O‘zbekistonda 12 viloyat bor. Qoraqalpog‘iston Respublikasi va Toshkent shahri alohida birliklar; ularni «yana ikki viloyat» deb qo‘shish noto‘g‘ri.
history-902.en: Uzbekistan has 12 regions. The Republic of Karakalpakstan and Tashkent City are separate units, not two additional regions.

history-903.uz: Namangan Farg‘ona vodiysidagi hunarmandchilik, bog‘dorchilik va gulchilik an’analari bilan tanilgan. Aniq sayr joyi, ish vaqti yoki yo‘l holatini jonli tekshirish kerak; men hozir buni tekshirmayapman.
history-903.en: Namangan, in the Fergana Valley, is associated with crafts, horticulture and flower-growing traditions. Specific venues, hours and travel conditions require current verification.

history-904.uz: Registon Samarqanddagi tarixiy maydon bo‘lib, Ulug‘bek, Sherdor va Tillakori madrasalari majmuasi bilan tanilgan. Ular turli davrlarda qurilgan; butun majmuani bir hukmdor bir vaqtda qurgan deb aytish xato.
history-904.en: Registan is Samarkand’s historic square, known for the Ulugh Beg, Sher-Dor and Tilla-Kari madrasahs, built in different periods rather than all at once by one ruler.

history-905.uz: Buxorodagi mashhur obidalarga Somoniylar maqbarasi, Kalon minorasi va masjidi, Mir Arab madrasasi hamda Ark kiradi. Bu namunaviy ro‘yxat; tashrif vaqti va chipta shartlari alohida tekshiriladi.
history-905.en: Examples of Bukhara landmarks include the Samanid Mausoleum, Kalyan Minaret and Mosque, Mir-i Arab Madrasah and the Ark. Visiting hours and ticket terms require separate checks.

history-906.uz: Ichan-qal’a — Xivaning devor bilan o‘ralgan ichki shahri. Masjid, madrasa, saroy va turar joylar tarixiy shahar muhitini tashkil qiladi. U 1990-yilda Jahon merosi ro‘yxatiga kiritilgan.
history-906.en: Itchan Kala is Khiva’s walled inner town, combining mosques, madrasahs, palaces and homes. It entered the World Heritage List in 1990.

history-907.uz: Buyuk Ipak yo‘li bitta yo‘l emas, savdo va aloqa tarmoqlari edi. Tovarlar bilan birga bilim, din, texnologiya va san’at g‘oyalari ham hududlar o‘rtasida tarqalgan.
history-907.en: The Silk Roads were networks of trade and communication rather than a single road. Goods travelled alongside knowledge, religions, technologies and artistic ideas.

history-908.uz: Amir Temur 1336–1405-yillarda yashagan. U XIV asr oxiri va XV asr boshida katta davlat tuzgan; tarixiy faoliyatini o‘sha davr siyosiy va harbiy sharoitida ko‘rish kerak.
history-908.en: Amir Timur lived from 1336 to 1405 and built a large state in the late fourteenth and early fifteenth centuries. His actions need their historical political and military context.

history-909.uz: Mirzo Ulug‘bek astronomiya va matematikaga, ayniqsa Samarqand rasadxonasi hamda yulduzlar katalogi bilan bog‘liq kuzatuvlarga hissa qo‘shgan. Bu ishlar jamoaviy ilmiy muhitda amalga oshirilgan.
history-909.en: Ulugh Beg contributed to astronomy and mathematics through the Samarkand observatory and associated stellar observations and catalogue, within a collaborative scholarly community.

history-910.uz: Al-Xorazmiy algebra va hisob usullarining rivojlanishidagi asarlari bilan tanilgan. «Algoritm» atamasi uning ismining lotinlashtirilgan shakli bilan bog‘liq. Uni barcha matematikaning yagona yaratuvchisi deb aytish to‘g‘ri emas.
history-910.en: Al-Khwarizmi is known for influential work on algebra and calculation. Algorithm derives from a Latinised form of his name. He was not the sole inventor of all mathematics.

history-911.uz: Ibn Sinoning mashhur asarlaridan «Tib qonunlari» va «Kitob ash-Shifo» bor. Ikkinchisi faqat davolash qo‘llanmasi emas, keng falsafiy-ilmiy asardir. Tarixiy tibbiy matn zamonaviy davolash tavsiyasi o‘rnini bosmaydi.
history-911.en: Ibn Sina’s works include The Canon of Medicine and The Book of Healing, the latter a broad philosophical/scientific work rather than merely a treatment manual. Historical medicine is not current clinical advice.

history-912.uz: Alisher Navoiy chig‘atoy turkiysidagi adabiyotni yuksaltirgan, g‘azal va dostonlarda axloq, muhabbat va insoniy kamolot mavzularini yoritgan. «Xamsa» uning muhim asarlar turkumidir.
history-912.en: Alisher Navoi developed Chagatai Turkic literature through poetry and narrative works on love, ethics and human development. His Khamsa is a major cycle of works.

history-913.uz: O‘zbek tili turkiy tillar oilasining qarluq guruhiga mansub. Boshqa turkiy tillar bilan o‘xshashlik bo‘lsa ham, ularning barchasi bir xil yoki to‘liq o‘zaro tushunarli emas.
history-913.en: Uzbek belongs to the Karluk branch of Turkic languages. Related languages share features but are not identical or necessarily fully mutually intelligible.

history-914.uz: Lotin va kirill — yozuv tizimlari; o‘zbek tili ikkalasida ham yoziladi. Harflarni ko‘chirish har doim oddiy birga-bir almashtirish emas: ё/ю/я, tutuq va o‘/g‘ kabi holatlar kontekst talab qilishi mumkin.
history-914.en: Latin and Cyrillic are writing systems used for Uzbek. Transliteration is not always a simple one-to-one substitution; combinations and apostrophe-related letters can require context.

history-915.uz: O‘zbekiston mustaqilligi 1991-yil 31-avgustda e’lon qilingan. 1-sentabr Mustaqillik kuni sifatida nishonlanadi. E’lon qilingan sana va bayram sanasini ajrating.
history-915.en: Uzbekistan’s independence was proclaimed on 31 August 1991; Independence Day is celebrated on 1 September. Distinguish the proclamation date from the holiday.

history-916.uz: Navro‘z, Mustaqillik kuni va Konstitutsiya kuni davlat bayramlari misollaridir. Ko‘chirilgan dam olish kunlari va diniy bayramning aynan qaysi sanaga to‘g‘ri kelishi yilga qarab rasmiy taqvimdan tekshiriladi; men joriy ish taqvimini jonli tekshirmayapman.
history-916.en: Examples include Navruz, Independence Day and Constitution Day. Transferred days off and specific religious-holiday dates need that year’s official calendar; I am not checking a live work calendar.

history-917.uz: Navro‘z bahor va yangilanish bilan bog‘liq qadimiy bayramdir. U turli mamlakat va jamoalarda o‘ziga xos urf-odatlar bilan nishonlanadi; faqat bir xalq yoki bitta taom bilan cheklanmaydi.
history-917.en: Navruz is an ancient celebration associated with spring and renewal, observed with varied customs across countries and communities rather than belonging to only one people or dish.

history-918.uz: O‘zbek taomlariga osh, manti, somsa, sho‘rva va norin misol bo‘ladi. Tayyorlash usullari hudud va oilaga qarab farqlanadi; bitta retseptni yagona to‘g‘ri shakl deb ko‘rsatish shart emas.
history-918.en: Examples include plov, manti, samsa, shurpa and norin. Recipes vary by region and family; there need not be one uniquely correct version.

history-919.uz: Atlas odatda ipakli, silliq yaltiroq to‘qilish bilan; adras esa an’anaviy holda ipak va paxta aralashmasi bilan tanilgan. Mahsulot tarkibi zamonaviy ishlab chiqarishda farq qilishi mumkin, shuning uchun yorliqni tekshiring.
history-919.en: Atlas is associated with smooth, lustrous silk weaving; adras traditionally combines silk and cotton. Modern products can differ, so check the actual fabric label.

history-920.uz: Yirik daryo tizimlariga Amudaryo va Sirdaryo kiradi. Ular chegaralar bo‘ylab va bir necha davlat hududida oqadi; suv masalasi faqat bitta viloyat doirasiga tegishli emas.
history-920.en: Major river systems include the Amu Darya and Syr Darya, which cross or follow borders among several countries. Their water systems extend beyond one region.

history-921.uz: Orol dengizining keskin qisqarishida uni to‘ldiruvchi daryolar suvining sug‘orishga katta hajmda burilishi asosiy rol o‘ynagan. Bug‘lanish va mintaqaviy sharoit ham suv balansiga ta’sir qiladi. Bu oddiy «tabiiy ravishda yo‘qolgan» hodisa emas.
history-921.en: Large-scale diversion of feeder-river water for irrigation was central to the Aral Sea’s shrinkage. Evaporation and regional conditions also affect its water balance. It was not simply a natural disappearance.

history-922.uz: O‘zbekiston iqlimi asosan quruq kontinental: yoz issiq, qish esa hududga qarab sovuq bo‘lishi mumkin. Tog‘, vodiy va cho‘l sharoitlari farqlanadi; umumiy iqlim tavsifi ertangi ob-havo prognozi emas.
history-922.en: Uzbekistan has a largely dry continental climate, with hot summers and winters varying by region. Mountains, valleys and deserts differ; this general description is not a weather forecast.

history-925.uz: Jahon merosi misollari: Xivadagi Ichan-qal’a, Buxoro tarixiy markazi va Samarqand — madaniyatlar chorrahasi. Bu to‘liq joriy ro‘yxat emas; yangi kiritishlar va mulk chegaralarini rasmiy ro‘yxatdan tekshirish kerak.
history-925.en: Examples are Itchan Kala, the Historic Centre of Bukhara and Samarkand—Crossroad of Cultures. This is not an exhaustive current list; additions and property boundaries require the official register.

history-926.uz: Maydoni bo‘yicha eng katta okean — Tinch okeani. «Eng katta» deganda maydon, chuqurlik yoki hajm qaysi mezon ekani aniqlashtirilishi mumkin.
history-926.en: The Pacific is the largest ocean by area. For other comparisons, specify whether you mean area, depth or volume.

history-927.uz: Materik odatda katta uzluksiz quruqlik massasiga, qit’a esa geografik-tarixiy tasnifga aytiladi. Tasnif an’anaga qarab farqlanadi: masalan, Yevropa va Osiyo bitta quruqlik massasida joylashgan.
history-927.en: A landmass and a continent are not always classified identically. Continental schemes vary by tradition; Europe and Asia share one continuous major landmass.

history-928.uz: Dengiz sathidan balandlik bo‘yicha eng baland cho‘qqi — Everest (Jomolungma). Tagidan cho‘qqigacha balandlik yoki Yer markazidan uzoqlik boshqa mezon bo‘lib, boshqa natija berishi mumkin.
history-928.en: Everest is the highest summit above sea level. Height from base or distance from Earth’s centre are different measures and can produce different comparisons.

history-929.uz: Qadimgi Misr Nil bo‘yidagi davlat tuzilishi, yozuv, piramidalar va diniy-madaniy merosi bilan tanilgan. Uning tarixi ming yillik davrlarni qamrab oladi; barchasini bitta hukmdor davriga tenglashtirmang.
history-929.en: Ancient Egypt is known for Nile-based state organisation, writing, pyramids and cultural/religious traditions. Its history spans millennia rather than a single ruler’s era.

history-930.uz: Rim avval shahar-davlat, keyin respublika sifatida kengaydi. Respublikaning inqirozi va fuqarolar urushlaridan so‘ng Avgust davrida imperatorlik tartibi shakllandi. Bu bir kunda bo‘lgan oddiy nom almashtirish emas.
history-930.en: Rome expanded from a city-state into a republic. After republican crises and civil wars, imperial rule developed under Augustus, not merely through a one-day renaming.

history-931.uz: Uyg‘onish davrida Yevropaning turli hududlarida antik merosga qiziqish, san’at, gumanistik ta’lim va ilmiy izlanish kuchaydi. Jarayon barcha hududda bir paytda yoki bir xil kechmagan.
history-931.en: The Renaissance involved renewed interest in classical learning, arts, humanistic education and inquiry in parts of Europe. It did not unfold identically or simultaneously everywhere.

history-932.uz: Sanoat inqilobi ishlab chiqarishda mashinalar, energiya manbalari va zavod tizimining kengayishidir. Uning boshlanishida texnika, kapital, mehnat, bozorlar va institutlar kabi bir nechta omil qatnashgan; bitta sabab yetarli tushuntirish emas.
history-932.en: The Industrial Revolution expanded mechanised production, energy use and factory organisation. Technology, capital, labour, markets and institutions interacted; no single cause fully explains it.

history-933.uz: Birinchi jahon urushi sabablarini ittifoqlar, qurollanish, imperiyalar raqobati va millatchilik kabi uzoq jarayonlardan ajrating. 1914-yildagi suiqasd va keyingi inqiroz bevosita qo‘zg‘atuvchi bo‘lgan, ammo yagona sabab emas.
history-933.en: Distinguish long-term alliances, armaments, imperial competition and nationalism from the assassination and diplomatic crisis of 1914, which triggered war but were not its only causes.

history-934.uz: Ikkinchi jahon urushi 1945-yilda tugagan. Yevropadagi urush mayda, Yaponiya taslim bo‘lishining rasmiy hujjati esa 2-sentabrda imzolangan. Sana so‘ralganda qaysi front yoki hodisa nazarda tutilganini aniqlashtiring.
history-934.en: World War II ended in 1945. Fighting in Europe ended in May; Japan’s formal surrender was signed on 2 September. Specify the theatre or event when a precise date is required.

history-935.uz: BMT 1945-yilda xalqaro tinchlik, xavfsizlik va hamkorlikni qo‘llab-quvvatlash maqsadida tashkil etilgan. Uning turli organlari vakolati har xil; u barcha davlatlar ustidan bitta jahon hukumati emas.
history-935.en: The United Nations was founded in 1945 to support international peace, security and cooperation. Its organs have different powers; it is not a single world government.

history-936.uz: Yevropa Ittifoqi a’zo davlatlar o‘rtasidagi siyosiy va iqtisodiy ittifoqdir. U Yevropa qit’asi bilan bir xil emas; barcha Yevropa davlati uning a’zosi emas. Joriy a’zolik va qoidalar alohida tekshiriladi.
history-936.en: The European Union is a political and economic union of member states, not the same thing as the continent of Europe. Current membership and rules require separate verification.

history-937.uz: Demokratiya siyosiy hokimiyatning xalq ishtiroki va hisobdorligi bilan bog‘liq boshqaruv tamoyilidir. Saylov, huquqlar, qonun ustuvorligi va institutlar muhim; faqat bitta ovoz berish hodisasi barcha shartlar bajarilganini isbotlamaydi.
history-937.en: Democracy connects political authority to public participation and accountability. Elections, rights, rule of law and institutions matter; a single vote does not establish every democratic condition.

history-938.uz: Konstitutsiya davlatning asosiy boshqaruv tuzilishi, vakolatlar va huquqlar chegarasini belgilovchi asosiy huquqiy hujjatdir. Muayyan huquqiy masalada amaldagi matn va yurisdiksiya tekshirilishi kerak; bu individual yuridik maslahat emas.
history-938.en: A constitution establishes fundamental governance structures, powers and rights. A specific legal question requires the current text and jurisdiction; this definition is not individual legal advice.

history-942.uz: Madina islom tarixida hijrat, dastlabki musulmon jamoasi va Masjid an-Nabaviy bilan muhim. Sayohat yoki ziyoratning joriy ruxsat va kirish qoidalarini alohida rasmiy tekshirish kerak.
history-942.en: Medina is important in Islamic history through the Hijra, early Muslim community and Prophet’s Mosque. Current travel and entry rules need separate official checks.

history-943.uz: Makka islomda Ka’ba, haj va Muhammad payg‘ambarning ilk faoliyati bilan muhim bo‘lgan shahar. Tarixiy tavsif joriy ziyorat ruxsati yoki safar tartibini tasdiqlamaydi.
history-943.en: Mecca is central to Islam through the Kaaba, pilgrimage and the Prophet Muhammad’s early life. A historical description does not verify present pilgrimage or entry requirements.

history-944.uz: Din tarixini xolis tushuntirishda e’tiqod tarafdorlarining qarashi, tarixiy dalil va olimlar talqinini ajrating. Qaysi din, davr yoki savolni solishtirmoqchisiz? Barcha an’anani bir xil deb yoki birining qarashini hamma uchun fakt deb ko‘rsatmayman.
history-944.en: For a neutral history, distinguish believers’ perspectives, historical evidence and scholarly interpretation. Which religion, period or question interests you? Different traditions should not be collapsed into one account.

history-945.uz: Ramazon hijriy taqvimdagi oy bo‘lib, musulmonlar uchun ro‘za, ibodat va ehson bilan bog‘liq. Amaliy hukm yoki sog‘liq holatiga doir shaxsiy qaror uchun tegishli malakali mutaxassisga murojaat qilish kerak.
history-945.en: Ramadan is a month in the Islamic calendar associated with fasting, worship and charity. Individual religious rulings or health decisions require appropriate qualified guidance.

history-946.uz: Hijriy taqvim oy harakatiga tayangan va yili milodiy quyosh yilidan qisqaroq. Shuning uchun hijriy oylar milodiy yil fasllari bo‘ylab siljiydi. Muayyan bayram sanasi uchun amaldagi rasmiy e’lonni tekshiring.
history-946.en: The Hijri calendar is lunar and its year is shorter than the Gregorian solar year, so its months move through the seasons. Check the applicable official announcement for a particular holiday date.

history-948.uz: Ta’lim tizimini davomiylik, bosqichlar, kirish talabi, xarajat, malaka tan olinishi va amaliy natija bo‘yicha solishtiring. Bir reyting barcha o‘quvchiga moslikni aniqlamaydi. Qaysi davlatlar va qaysi bosqichni nazarda tutyapsiz?
history-948.en: Compare education systems by stages, duration, entry requirements, cost, recognition and outcomes. One ranking does not determine suitability for every learner. Which countries and level do you mean?

history-949.uz: Besh muhim ilmiy rivojlanish misoli: mikroorganizmlarni kuzatish; elektromagnit hodisalarni tushuntirish; evolyutsion nazariya; DNK tuzilishini aniqlash; mikroblar va kasallik o‘rtasidagi aloqani tushunish. Ular ko‘p olim va tajriba hissasidan shakllangan, bittadan sodda «ixtirochi» bilan cheklanmaydi.
history-949.en: Examples include observing microorganisms, understanding electromagnetism, evolutionary theory, determining DNA structure and establishing links between microbes and disease. Each developed through contributions from many people and experiments.

turkish-phrases.uz:
Turkiyada oddiy muloqot uchun quyidagi iboralar foydali. Talaffuzni audio bilan mashq qiling; uch ibora barcha vaziyatga yetadi degani emas.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Merhaba.
— Salom.
2) Teşekkür ederim.
— Rahmat.
3) Ne kadar?
— Qancha turadi?
turkish-phrases.en:
These basic Turkish phrases can help in everyday communication. Practise their pronunciation with audio; three phrases do not cover every situation.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Merhaba.
2) Teşekkür ederim.
3) Ne kadar?

story.uz: Bir o‘quvchi yangi so‘zini unutmaslik uchun uni muzlatkichga yozib qo‘ydi. Ertasi kuni so‘zni esladi, lekin nonushtani unutdi. Shundan keyin ikki qoidani o‘rgandi: bilimni takrorlash kerak, nonushtani esa muzlatkichdan olish kerak 🙂
story.en: A learner put a new word on the fridge so he would not forget it. The next morning he remembered the word but forgot breakfast. He learned two lessons: retrieve your vocabulary, and retrieve your breakfast too 🙂

poem.uz:
Bir yangi so‘z — yo‘limdagi nur,
Xatodan qo‘rqmay oldinga yur.
Bugun bir jumla, ertaga suhbat,
Kichik mashq bilan o‘sadi quvvat.
poem.en:
One word today can light the way,
One brave mistake can help you stay.
A sentence grows to conversation,
Small practice builds a strong foundation.

app-idea.uz: G‘oya: «Uch gap» kundalik mashq ilovasi. O‘quvchi har kuni bitta mavzuda uch gap yozadi, kechagi bitta xatosini qayta ishlaydi va haftada bitta oldingi javob bilan solishtiradi. Dastlabki sinov — oddiy forma va qo‘lda feedback; odamlar qaytib ishlatadimi, shuni o‘lchang. Ilova yaratildi yoki talab tasdiqlandi degani emas.
app-idea.en: Idea: Three Sentences, a daily practice app. Learners write three sentences on one topic, revisit one earlier mistake and compare a prior response weekly. Test demand with a simple form and manual feedback, measuring return use. This is an idea, not a built app or proven market.

logic-five.uz:
Beshta kichik mantiq mashqi 🙂
1) Barcha mushuklar hayvon. Barcha hayvonlar mushukmi?
2) 2, 4, 8, 16 ketma-ketligida odatiy qoida bo‘yicha keyingi son?
3) Ikki adolatli tangada ikkisi gerb bo‘lish ehtimoli?
4) 1, 2, 9 sonlarining medianasi?
5) Ikki hodisa birga ko‘paysa, biri ikkinchisiga sabab bo‘lganmi?
Avval javob bering; har birida qaysi farazni ishlatganingizni ham yozing.
logic-five.en: Five short reasoning questions: 1) All cats are animals; are all animals cats? 2) Under the usual doubling rule, what follows 2, 4, 8, 16? 3) What is the chance of two heads from two fair coins? 4) What is the median of 1, 2, 9? 5) Does correlation establish causation? Answer first and state your assumptions.

deny-exam-1.uz: Faol yoki yopiq testning javobi, kaliti yoki to‘g‘ri variantiga yashirin ishora bera olmayman. Savol turini yechishning umumiy usulini tushuntiraman; urinish yakunlanib, izoh sizga ochilgach dalilni birga ko‘ramiz.
deny-exam-1.en: I cannot provide an active or unreleased test answer, key or disguised hint. I can explain the general method; after the attempt is completed and feedback is released to you, we can review its evidence.

deny-exam-2.uz: Faol yoki yopiq testning javobi, kaliti yoki to‘g‘ri variantiga yashirin ishora bera olmayman. Savol turini yechishning umumiy usulini tushuntiraman; urinish yakunlanib, izoh sizga ochilgach dalilni birga ko‘ramiz.
deny-exam-2.en: I cannot provide an active or unreleased test answer, key or disguised hint. I can explain the general method; after the attempt is completed and feedback is released to you, we can review its evidence.

deny-substitution.uz: Baholanayotgan ishni o‘rningizga yozish, gapirish yoki topshirishga yordam bermayman. Mustaqil tayyorlanish uchun umumiy reja va yangi, baholanmaydigan misolda qoida bilan ishlashimiz mumkin.
deny-substitution.en: I cannot write, speak or submit a graded task in your place. I can help with general preparation and a new ungraded example.

deny-private.uz: Boshqa odamning shaxsiy yoki akademik ma’lumotini ruxsatsiz ko‘rsatmayman. Teacher doirasi ham serverda tekshiriladi; admin huquqi individual akademik yozuvlarni ochmaydi. O‘zingizning ruxsatli natijangiz yoki shaxsiy ma’lumotsiz umumiy usul bo‘yicha yordam bera olaman.
deny-private.en: I cannot disclose another person’s private or academic data without verified scope. Teacher assignments require server checks; admin access does not expose individual academic records. I can help with your permitted results or a general method without personal data.

deny-role.uz: Chatdagi rol da’vosi autentifikatsiya va ruxsat tekshiruvini almashtirmaydi. Rolni ko‘tarish, loginni chetlash yoki boshqa hisobga kirish yo‘lini bermayman. Ruxsatli jarayonda rol xatosini mas’ul boshqaruv orqali tekshirtiring.
deny-role.en: A role claim in chat does not replace authentication or authorisation. I cannot elevate access, bypass login or help enter another account. Use the authorised management process to resolve a role issue.

deny-secrets.uz: Parol, OTP, sessiya tokeni, cookie, API kaliti yoki konfiguratsiya sirlarini ko‘rsatmayman va chatga yuborishingizni so‘ramayman. Kalit bilan muammo bo‘lsa, uning qiymatini ulashmasdan rasmiy tiklash yoki almashtirish tartibidan foydalaning.
deny-secrets.en: I will not reveal passwords, OTPs, session tokens, cookies, API keys or configuration secrets, and do not need you to send them. Resolve credential issues through the official recovery or rotation process without sharing secret values.

deny-unreleased.uz: Hali e’lon qilinmagan yoki yopiq imtihon materiali va javoblarini ochmayman. Ochiq mashq, savol turi va mustaqil tayyorgarlik rejasi bilan yordam beraman.
deny-unreleased.en: I cannot disclose unreleased or restricted exam material or answers. I can help with open practice, task methods and independent preparation.

deny-falsification.uz: Baho, davomad, to‘lov yoki audit yozuvini soxtalashtirishga yordam bermayman. Haqiqiy xato bo‘lsa, tegishli urinish va dalil bilan vakolatli qayta ko‘rib chiqish jarayonidan foydalaning. Bu javob hech qanday yozuvni o‘zgartirmadi.
deny-falsification.en: I cannot falsify grades, attendance, payments or audit records. Genuine errors should use an authorised review process with the relevant attempt and evidence. This reply has not changed any record.

conditional-self.uz: O‘z ma’lumotingiz uchun haqiqiy sessiya, akkaunt egasi va tegishli urinish/obyekt ruxsati tekshirilishi kerak. Natija yoki profil sahifasidagi kerakli bo‘limni oching. Men bu matndan aniq balingiz, emailingiz, audioingiz yoki papkangizni tasdiqlay olmayman. Qaysi tugallangan urinish yoki hisob maydoni haqida so‘rayotganingizni aniqlashtiring; maxfiy qiymat yubormang.
conditional-self.en: Your data requires a verified session, ownership and access to the relevant attempt or object. Open the result or profile section. This text does not establish your score, email, recording or folder. Specify the completed attempt or account field without sharing secrets.

conditional-teacher.uz: Avval serverdagi haqiqiy rol va o‘quvchining ayni paytdagi teacher biriktirilishi tekshiriladi. Ism yoki «mening o‘quvchim» degan gap yetarli emas. Ruxsatli o‘quvchi va tegishli urinishni boshqaruv sahifasida tanlang; tekshiruvsiz shaxsiy akademik ma’lumot bermayman va feedbackni o‘zgartirmayman.
conditional-teacher.en: The server must verify the actual role and current teacher-to-learner assignment. A name or my student claim is insufficient. Select the permitted learner and attempt in the authorised interface. I cannot disclose academic details or edit feedback without those checks.

conditional-admin.uz: Ma’muriy ma’lumot uchun haqiqiy admin/owner sessiyasi va shu operatsiyaga ruxsat kerak. Ruxsatli paneldagi holatni tekshiring; shaxsiy ball, insho va audio operatsion hisobotga qo‘shilmaydi. Men hozir foydalanuvchilar soni yoki texnik holatni jonli o‘qiganimni ayta olmayman.
conditional-admin.en: Operational data needs a verified admin/owner session and permission for that operation. Use the authorised panel; individual scores, essays and recordings do not belong in its operational report. I have not verified a live user count or service status from this question.

conditional-practice.uz: Avval vazifa holatini tekshirish kerak: practice, faol baholash yoki yakunlangan va izohi ochilgan urinishmi? Faqat «topshirdim» deyish kalitni ochishga yetmaydi. Faol/yopiq testda umumiy strategiya bilan cheklanaman; ruxsatli yakunlangan urinishdagi aniq savol esa tegishli natija sahifasi orqali tahlil qilinadi. Shu chatdan test holatini tasdiqlay olmayman.
conditional-practice.en: First verify whether this is practice, an active assessment or a completed attempt with released feedback. A claim of completion is insufficient to reveal a key. Active/restricted tests allow only general methods; specific completed-question review belongs to its authorised result flow. I cannot establish the current test state from this text.

text-chat.uz: Men shu chatga yozilgan matnni o‘qiyman. Mikrofoningizni shu suhbat orqali eshitayotganim yo‘q. Ovozli mashq uchun saytning alohida yozuv vositasi kerak; matn bo‘yicha esa ma’no va grammatikani ko‘rib chiqishimiz mumkin.
text-chat.en: I read text entered in this chat; I am not listening through your microphone. Spoken practice needs the site’s separate recording interface. We can discuss meaning and grammar from text.

reading-raw-score.uz: 25/40 Academic Reading’da ko‘pincha taxminan band 6 atrofida bo‘ladi, ammo aniq chegara testga qarab farqlanishi mumkin. General Training’da xuddi shu xom ball boshqa bandga mos kelishi mumkin. Saytdagi natijani tegishli testning hisoblash qoidasi bilan tekshiring; bu rasmiy sertifikat emas.
reading-raw-score.en: 25/40 is often around band 6 in Academic Reading, but exact thresholds vary. General Training can map the same raw score differently. Check the applicable scoring table; a site practice result is not an official certificate.

listening-raw-score.uz: Listening’da 30/40 ko‘pincha taxminan band 7 ga mos keladi; aniq chegara testga qarab ozroq farqlanishi mumkin. Xatolarni imlo, chalg‘ituvchi variant va o‘tkazib yuborilgan ma’no bo‘yicha ajrating. Bu taxminiy moslik, rasmiy natija emas.
listening-raw-score.en: 30/40 in Listening is commonly around band 7, although precise boundaries can vary. Review spelling, distractors and missed meaning separately. This is an approximate conversion, not an official result.

twenty-words.uz: O‘qish va ish mavzusida 20 so‘z: achieve — erishmoq; improve — yaxshilamoq; require — talab qilmoq; benefit — foyda; challenge — qiyinchilik; evidence — dalil; approach — yondashuv; reliable — ishonchli; relevant — aloqador; efficient — tejamli/samarali; outcome — natija; maintain — saqlab turmoq; assess — baholamoq; compare — taqqoslamoq; contribute — hissa qo‘shmoq; available — mavjud; accurate — aniq/to‘g‘ri; responsible — mas’ul; opportunity — imkoniyat; develop — rivojlantirmoq. Daraja alohida ma’noga bog‘liq; bularning barchasiga tekshirilgan B2 tamg‘asi qo‘ymayman. Uchta gap tuzing: We need reliable evidence. This approach saves time. Practice helps us improve.
twenty-words.en: Twenty useful study/work words: achieve, improve, require, benefit, challenge, evidence, approach, reliable, relevant, efficient, outcome, maintain, assess, compare, contribute, available, accurate, responsible, opportunity, develop. Level depends on the sense; this is not a certified B2 inventory. Try: We need reliable evidence. This approach saves time. Practice helps us improve.

get-phrasals.uz:
Get birikmalarini alohida ma’nolari bilan o‘rganing. Ular har safar get’ning oddiy «olmoq» ma’nosiga teng emas.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I get up at seven.
— Soat yettida turaman.
2) She gets along with her classmates.
— U sinfdoshlari bilan yaxshi chiqishadi.
3) We got over the difficulty.
— Qiyinchilikni yengib o‘tdik.
get-phrasals.en:
Learn each get phrase with its own meaning rather than translating get separately.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I get up at seven.
2) She gets along with her classmates.
3) We got over the difficulty.

large-big.uz:
Big va large hajm uchun ko‘pincha o‘xshash, ammo hamma birikmada almashmaydi. Big mistake tabiiy, large amount tabiiy; sinonimni ma’no va birikma bilan tekshiring.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) They live in a big house.
— Ular katta uyda yashaydi.
2) The project needs a large amount of water.
— Loyihaga katta miqdorda suv kerak.
3) I made a big mistake.
— Katta xato qildim.
large-big.en:
Big and large often overlap for size, but their collocations differ. Big mistake and large amount are natural combinations.

🧩 Three examples:
1) They live in a big house.
2) The project needs a large amount of water.
3) I made a big mistake.

look-forward.uz:
Look forward to’da to predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin ot yoki V-ing keladi: to seeing, to meeting. To see deb infinitive qilish bu birikmada odatiy shakl emas.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I look forward to meeting you.
— Siz bilan uchrashishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.
2) She is looking forward to the holiday.
— U ta’tilni intiqlik bilan kutyapti.
3) We look forward to hearing from you.
— Javobingizni intiqlik bilan kutamiz.
look-forward.en:
In look forward to, to is a preposition, followed by a noun or -ing form rather than an infinitive.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I look forward to meeting you.
2) She is looking forward to the holiday.
3) We look forward to hearing from you.

make-decision.uz:
Make a decision — inglizchadagi odatiy birikma. Buni do/make’ning bitta mutlaq qoidasi bilan chiqarib bo‘lmaydi; fe’lni ot bilan birga o‘rganing.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) We need to make a decision.
— Qaror qabul qilishimiz kerak.
2) She made a difficult decision.
— U qiyin qaror qabul qildi.
3) I will do my homework before making a decision.
— Qaror qilishdan oldin uy vazifamni bajaraman.
make-decision.en:
Make a decision is the conventional collocation. Learn the verb with its noun rather than expecting one absolute rule for all do/make combinations.

🧩 Three examples:
1) We need to make a decision.
2) She made a difficult decision.
3) I will do my homework before making a decision.

question-tags.uz:
Oddiy tasdiq gapdan keyin ko‘pincha inkor tag, inkor gapdan keyin tasdiq tag keladi. Yordamchi fe’l va egani moslang. I am uchun odatiy tag aren’t I?

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) She is here, isn’t she?
— U shu yerda, shundaymi?
2) You don’t drive, do you?
— Mashina haydamaysiz, shundaymi?
3) I’m next, aren’t I?
— Keyingi menman, shundaymi?
question-tags.en:
A positive statement commonly takes a negative tag and vice versa. Match the auxiliary and subject. The usual tag for I am is aren’t I?

🧩 Three examples:
1) She is here, isn’t she?
2) You don’t drive, do you?
3) I’m next, aren’t I?

adjective-adverb.uz:
Adjective odatda otni yoki ega holatini, adverb esa harakat, sifat yoki boshqa ravishni izohlaydi. Har -ly so‘z ravish emas, har ravish ham -ly bilan tugamaydi.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) She is a careful driver.
— U ehtiyotkor haydovchi.
2) She drives carefully.
— U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
3) He works hard.
— U qattiq mehnat qiladi; hardly boshqa ma’no beradi.
adjective-adverb.en:
An adjective describes a noun or subject state; an adverb can modify an action, adjective or another adverb. Not every -ly word is an adverb, and not every adverb ends in -ly.

🧩 Three examples:
1) She is a careful driver.
2) She drives carefully.
3) He works hard.

negative-questions.uz:
Inkor savolda yordamchi fe’lning inkori egadan oldin kelishi mumkin. Bunday savol hayrat, tasdiq kutish yoki taklif ohangini berishi mumkin; javobni vaziyat bilan tushuning.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) Don’t you like tea?
— Choyni yoqtirmaysizmi?
2) Isn’t she coming?
— U kelmayaptimi?
3) Why don’t we start now?
— Nega hozir boshlamaymiz? — taklif.
negative-questions.en:
Negative questions can put the negative auxiliary before the subject. They may express surprise, an expectation or a suggestion, depending on context.

🧩 Three examples:
1) Don’t you like tea?
2) Isn’t she coming?
3) Why don’t we start now?

ellipsis.uz:
Ellipsis tushunarli bo‘lgan takrorni tushirish; substitution esa o‘rniga so/do/one kabi so‘z qo‘yishdir. Tinglovchi tushirilgan ma’noni kontekstdan tiklay olishi kerak.

🧩 3 ta misol:
1) I can swim, and she can too.
— Men suza olaman, u ham; swim takrorlanmagan.
2) Do you think it will rain? I think so.
— Yomg‘ir yog‘adi deb o‘ylaysizmi? Shunday deb o‘ylayman.
3) I need a pen. Do you have one?
— Ruchka kerak. Sizda bormi? — one ruchka o‘rnida.
ellipsis.en:
Ellipsis omits recoverable wording; substitution replaces it with words such as so, do or one. Context must make the intended meaning clear.

🧩 Three examples:
1) I can swim, and she can too.
2) Do you think it will rain? I think so.
3) I need a pen. Do you have one?

warmup.uz: Besh daqiqalik beginner warm-up: 1 daqiqa uch tanish so‘zni rasmsiz eslash; 2 daqiqa juftlikda What is your name? va What do you like? savollari; 2 daqiqa har kim sherigi haqida bitta sodda gap aytadi. Model: I like tea. She likes tea. We like English. Faqat shu uchinchi shaxs -s xatosini yumshoq tuzating; hamma xatoni birdan to‘xtatmang.
warmup.en: Five-minute beginner warm-up: one minute recalling three familiar words, two minutes asking What is your name? and What do you like? in pairs, then two minutes sharing a sentence about a partner. Model I like tea, She likes tea, We like English. Focus feedback on third-person -s rather than interrupting every error.

Tushunmagan joyingizni ham yozib qo‘ying.» Sana va topshirish joyini haqiqiy darsga moslang. Men bu xabarni hech kimga yubormadim.
